exercises.explanation: Paragraf güvenli asansörün yüksek binaların önündeki engeli nasıl kaldırdığını ve gökdelenlere yol açtığını anlatır. ‘IV’ numaralı cümle de Otis'ten söz eder ama binalardan ayrılıp onun ölümüne ve aile şirketine geçer. ‘I’ eski binaların alçaklığını, ‘II’ bunun nedenini, ‘III’ bu engeli kaldıran icadı, ‘V’ ise asansörün çelik iskeletle birlikte gökdelenleri mümkün kıldığını anlatır.

units.title: Ara tekrar 2
units.description: Yarım deneme 3 öncesi karışık tekrar: dilbilgisi, cloze, çeviri, okuma ve paragraf soruları
units.guide:
## Bu haftaya kadar gördüğün soru tipleri
- **Kelime ve dilbilgisi:** zamanlar, kipler, edilgen, koşul, sıfat ve isim cümlecikleri, gerund/infinitive, bağlaçlar.
- **Cloze ve cümle tamamlama:** boşluğun önüne ve arkasına bak; bağlacı, zamanı ve yapıyı birlikte kontrol et.
- **Çeviri:** önce ana yüklemi ve zamanı bul, sonra *although, unless, the more…the more* gibi kalıpları eşleştir.
- **Okuma, diyalog, yeniden ifade, paragraf tamamlama, anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle.**

## Yarım deneme 3 için zaman planı (90 dakika)
- Kelime ve dilbilgisi: **20 dk**
- Cloze ve cümle tamamlama: **25 dk**
- Okuma parçaları: **30 dk**
- Çeviri, diyalog ve paragraf soruları: **15 dk**
- Bir soruda 2 dakikadan fazla kalırsan işaretle ve geç; sona kalan sürede dön.

## Denemeden sonra
- Her yanlışını **Hata defteri**ne yaz ve nedenini işaretle: kelime mi, yapı mı, dikkat mi, süre mi?
- En çok yanlış yaptığın soru tipini seç ve o tipte 10 soruyu yeniden çöz.
- Doğru yaptığın ama emin olmadığın soruların açıklamalarını da oku; şans eseri doğru cevap, bir sonraki denemede yanlışa dönebilir.
- Bir hafta sonra Hata defterindeki soruları açıklamaya bakmadan tekrar çöz.

exercises.passage: In 1693, the astronomer Edmond Halley, (1)---- name is now linked mainly to a famous comet, published a short paper on a very different subject. The Polish city of Breslau had kept careful records of births and deaths for several years, and Halley used them to estimate how many people of each age (2)---- survive to their next birthday. Until then, the English government had charged the same price for a pension that paid a fixed sum every year for life, (3)---- the buyer was twenty or sixty years old. As a result, older buyers received a bargain at the public's expense. Halley showed that a fair price depended on the probability of the buyer (4)---- alive in each future year. (5)----, his table was largely ignored for decades, and only in the following century did insurance companies begin to base their prices on such calculations.
exercises.question: (1) numaralı boşluk için en uygun ifadeyi seçin.
options: who
which
whose
whom
that

(5)----, his table was largely ignored for decades, and only in the following century did insurance companies begin to base their prices on such calculations.

had repeated

exercises.explanation: ‘By the time’ + geçmiş zaman (were published), o andan önce tamamlanmış bir eylemi gerektirir; bu yüzden past perfect ‘had repeated’ doğrudur. ‘has repeated’ şimdiye bağlanır, ‘repeats’ geniş zamandır, ‘will repeat’ gelecek, ‘is repeating’ şimdiki zamandır; hiçbiri geçmişteki bir andan önceyi anlatmaz.

options: can't have
needn't have
should have
would have
must have
exercises.explanation: Konuşan, altı kez üst üste altı gelmesinden zarların hileli olduğu sonucunu çıkarıyor; geçmişe dair güçlü olumlu çıkarım ‘must have’ ile yapılır. ‘can't have’ tam tersini (olamaz) söyler, ‘needn't have’ gereksiz yapılmış bir işi, ‘should have’ yapılması gerekeni, ‘would have’ koşula bağlı bir sonucu anlatır.

options: is estimated

is estimating
estimated
exercises.explanation: ‘It + edilgen fiil + that’ kalıbı (It is said/thought/estimated that) genel bir kanıyı aktarır; özne tahmin eden kişi değil, ‘it’tir. Bu yüzden edilgen ‘is estimated’ doğrudur. ‘estimates’, ‘estimated’, ‘has estimated’ ve ‘is estimating’ etken çatıdır; ‘it’ tahmin yapan biri olamaz.

exercises.question: ---- the weather service warned us earlier, we would not have set off for the mountain.
options: If
Should
Had
Were
Unless
exercises.explanation: Ana cümle ‘would not have set off’ geçmişe dair üçüncü tip koşuldur; yan cümlede ‘warned’ (V3) ile devrik ‘Had the weather service warned’ (If … had warned) kurulur. ‘If’ ile ‘had warned’ gerekirdi; ‘Should’ birinci tip, ‘Were’ ikinci tip devrik koşuldur; ‘Unless’ ise anlamı tersine çevirir.

exercises.question: The researchers could not say ---- the new drug would work for older patients as well.
options: what
which
unless
whether
so that
exercises.explanation: ‘say’ fiilinin nesnesi olan isim cümleciği ‘olup olmadığı’ anlamı taşımalıdır: ilacın yaşlılarda da işe yarayıp yaramayacağı. Bunu ‘whether’ kurar. ‘what’ ve ‘which’ cümlede eksik bir öğe ister ama cümle tamdır; ‘unless’ koşul, ‘so that’ amaç bildirir ve ‘say’ fiilinin nesnesi olamaz.

exercises.question: Please remember ---- the windows before you leave; heavy rain is very likely tonight.
options: to close
closing
close
having closed
to be closed
exercises.explanation: ‘remember + to V’ yapılacak bir işi unutmamayı, ‘remember + V-ing’ geçmişte yapılmış bir işi hatırlamayı anlatır. Burada iş henüz yapılmadığı için ‘to close’ doğrudur. ‘closing’ ve ‘having closed’ geçmiş anıyı, ‘close’ yalın hâli (remember ile kullanılmaz), ‘to be closed’ ise edilgendir; pencereyi kapatan sizsiniz.

exercises.question: ---- the chance of a major earthquake in any given year is small, the city requires every new building to withstand one.
options: Because
Unless
So that
Although
In case
exercises.explanation: Olasılık düşük olduğu hâlde şehir yine de önlem alıyor; bu beklenmedik zıtlığı ‘Although’ kurar. ‘Because’ olasılığın düşüklüğünü önlemin nedeni yapar ki mantıksızdır; ‘Unless’ olumsuz koşul, ‘So that’ amaç, ‘In case’ ihtimale karşı önlem bildirir ve cümlenin anlamını bozar.

nodes.title: Cümle tamamlama ve çeviri
nodes.description: Cümle tamamlama ile İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce çeviri

exercises.question: Unless the blood samples are stored at a low temperature, ----.
options: the researchers had checked them twice
they may lose much of their value for the study
which the laboratory bought last year
if the freezer had not broken down
so the results were published in a journal
exercises.explanation: ‘Unless’ (-medikçe) ile kurulan gerçek bir koşula olası bir sonuç gerekir: örnekler soğukta saklanmazsa çalışma için değerini yitirebilir (‘they may lose much of their value’). ‘had checked’ zaman uyumunu bozar, ‘laboratory bought’ sıfat cümleciği bağlanacak isim bulamaz, ‘freezer had not broken’ ikinci bir koşuldur, ‘journal’ seçeneği ise geçmiş zamanla anlamsız bir sonuç kurar.

exercises.question: The insurance company raised its prices for drivers under twenty-five ----.
options: even though young drivers have far fewer accidents than older ones
so that the police could stop more cars on motorways
until no driver had ever been injured
that most passengers prefer travelling by train
because young drivers are statistically more likely to have accidents
exercises.explanation: Fiyat artışının mantıklı nedeni gençlerin istatistiksel olarak daha çok kaza yapmasıdır (‘because … more likely to have accidents’). ‘even though … fewer accidents’ zıtlığı mantıksızdır; ‘police … motorways’ amacı sigortayla ilgisizdir; ‘until no driver … injured’ anlamsız bir zaman sınırıdır; ‘passengers … train’ ise cümleye bağlanamayan bir isim cümleciğidir.

exercises.question: If the coin had been perfectly balanced, ----.
options: heads comes up in most of the games
we will toss it a hundred more times
heads and tails would have come up about equally often
it was made of a cheaper metal
the players are going to lose interest
exercises.explanation: ‘If … had been’ üçüncü tip koşuldur ve ana cümlede ‘would have + V3’ ister: ‘heads and tails would have come up about equally often’. ‘comes up’ geniş zaman, ‘will toss’ ve ‘are going to lose’ gelecek zaman, ‘cheaper metal’ seçeneği ise düz geçmiş zamandır; hiçbiri bu koşulla uyuşmaz.

exercises.question: What surprised the scientists most was ----.
options: because the rare event had happened twice
so that the rare event could happen again
unless the rare event happens twice
although the event was known to be rare
that the rare event happened twice in the same week
exercises.explanation: ‘What surprised … was’ yapısında ‘was’tan sonra bir isim cümleciği gelir: ‘that the rare event happened twice’. ‘because’ (neden), ‘so that’ (amaç), ‘unless’ (koşul) ve ‘although … known’ (zıtlık) zarf cümleciği kurar; ‘was’ fiilinin tümleci olamaz.

exercises.question: Instead of relying on a single study, ----.
options: a single study is rarely enough to prove anything
it was decided that more evidence was needed
the committee compared the results of more than twenty trials
there are many reasons to doubt the findings
if the results had been more reliable
exercises.explanation: ‘Instead of relying’ yapısının öznesi ana cümlenin öznesidir; güvenen kişi/kurum olmalıdır: ‘the committee compared …’. ‘single study … prove’ seçeneğinde çalışma kendine güvenir, ‘decided … evidence’ ve ‘reasons … doubt’ seçeneklerinde ‘it/there’ özne olamaz; ‘reliable’ ile biten seçenek ise tamamlanmamış bir koşuldur.

exercises.question: The researchers chose the participants at random ----.
options: so that every member of the population had the same chance of being selected
even though random selection was exactly what the protocol required
unless they want the sample to be fair
which most respondents were unable to understand
as if the results had been known to everyone already
exercises.explanation: Rastgele seçimin amacı herkese eşit seçilme şansı vermektir: ‘so that every member … had the same chance’. ‘even though … protocol’ mantıksız bir zıtlık kurar; ‘want … fair’ zaman uyumunu ve anlamı bozar; ‘respondents … understand’ sıfat cümleciği bir isme bağlanmaz; ‘as if … known’ ise anlamsız bir benzetmedir.

exercises.question:
Verilen İngilizce cümlenin Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?

Had the bridge been inspected more regularly, the accident could probably have been prevented.
options: Köprü düzenli olarak denetlendiği için kaza büyük olasılıkla önlendi.
Köprü daha düzenli denetlenseydi bile kaza yine de olabilirdi.
Kaza önlenmiş olsaydı köprünün daha düzenli denetlenmesine gerek kalmazdı.
Köprü daha düzenli denetlenmiş olsaydı, kaza muhtemelen önlenebilirdi.
Köprü daha sık denetlenmeli, yoksa kaza olasılığı artacak.
exercises.explanation: Devrik ‘Had … been inspected’ geçmişe dair gerçekleşmemiş koşuldur: ‘Köprü daha düzenli denetlenmiş olsaydı, kaza muhtemelen önlenebilirdi.’ ‘denetlendiği için … önlendi’ gerçekleşmiş bir olay anlatır; ‘bile … yine de’ anlamı tersine çevirir; ‘gerek kalmazdı’ neden-sonucu yer değiştirir; ‘yoksa … artacak’ ise geleceğe dönük bir uyarıdır.

exercises.question:
Verilen İngilizce cümlenin Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?

It is not the size of a risk but the way it is presented that shapes people's decisions.
options: Riskin büyüklüğü ve sunulma biçimi insanların kararlarını eşit ölçüde etkiler.
İnsanların kararlarını biçimlendiren şey riskin büyüklüğü değil, nasıl sunulduğudur.
İnsanlar riskleri sunarken büyüklüklerini çoğu zaman olduğundan farklı gösterir.
Bir riskin nasıl sunulduğu, büyüklüğü bilinmediğinde kararları etkilemez.
İnsanların kararları riskin büyüklüğüne göre değil, kendi deneyimlerine göre şekillenir.
exercises.explanation: ‘It is not … but … that’ vurgulu yapısı asıl etkenin sunuluş biçimi olduğunu söyler: ‘… riskin büyüklüğü değil, nasıl sunulduğudur.’ ‘eşit ölçüde’ iki etkeni denk tutar; ‘sunarken … gösterir’ öznenin kim olduğunu değiştirir; ‘bilinmediğinde … etkilemez’ olumsuz bir anlam kurar; ‘deneyimlerine’ ise metinde olmayan bir etken ekler.

exercises.question:
Verilen Türkçe cümlenin İngilizce karşılığı hangisidir?

Deneyin başka laboratuvarlarda tekrarlanması, sonuçların güvenilirliğini artırmıştır.
options: The experiment was replicated in other laboratories because its results were reliable.
Other laboratories have refused to replicate the experiment until its results are reliable.
The results would be more reliable if the experiment were replicated in other laboratories.
The replication of the experiment in other laboratories has increased the reliability of the results.
Replicating the experiment in other laboratories has made the results less accurate.
exercises.explanation: Türkçe cümlede tekrarlama (replication) öznedir ve güvenilirliği artırmıştır: ‘The replication of the experiment … has increased the reliability of the results.’ ‘because its results were reliable’ neden-sonucu ters çevirir; ‘refused’ olmayan bir reddetme ekler; ‘would be … if’ gerçekleşmiş olayı varsayıma çevirir; ‘less accurate’ ise anlamı tersine çevirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen Türkçe cümlenin İngilizce karşılığı hangisidir?

Ankete katılanların çoğu, sorulardan birini yanlış anladıklarını kabul etti.
options: Most of the respondents admitted that they had misunderstood one of the questions.
Most of the respondents claimed that one of the questions was impossible to answer.
Only a few respondents admitted that they had understood all of the questions.
The respondents were told that most of the questions had been written wrongly.
Most of the questions in the questionnaire were misunderstood by the researchers.
exercises.explanation: ‘Ankete katılanların çoğu’ = ‘Most of the respondents’, ‘yanlış anladıklarını kabul etti’ = ‘admitted that they had misunderstood’. ‘claimed … impossible’ farklı bir iddia, ‘Only a few … understood all’ farklı bir kabul, ‘were told … written wrongly’ edilgen ve başka bir bilgi, ‘misunderstood by the researchers’ ise yanlış anlayanı değiştirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen İngilizce cümlenin Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?

The more variables a model includes, the harder it becomes to interpret its results.
options: Bir modelin sonuçlarını yorumlamak için çok sayıda değişken gerekir.
Değişken sayısı arttıkça modelin sonuçları daha güvenilir hâle gelir.
Bir model ne kadar çok değişken içerirse sonuçlarını yorumlamak o kadar zorlaşır.
Az değişkenli modellerin sonuçlarını yorumlamak çoğu zaman imkânsızdır.
Bir model, sonuçları zor yorumlansa bile çok değişken içermelidir.
exercises.explanation: ‘The more …, the harder …’ yapısı iki şeyin birlikte arttığını anlatır: ‘ne kadar çok değişken içerirse … o kadar zorlaşır.’ ‘yorumlamak için … gerekir’ bir gereklilik, ‘güvenilir’ başka bir sonuç, ‘imkânsızdır’ ters ve abartılı bir yargı, ‘içermelidir’ ise öneri bildirir.

nodes.title: Okuma
nodes.description: İki uzun parça: ana fikir, ayrıntı, çıkarım, gönderim ve tutum

exercises.passage: On an August evening in 1913, the roulette wheel at the Monte Carlo Casino produced something that seemed impossible: the ball landed on black twenty-six times in a row. As the run grew longer, a crowd gathered around the table, and more and more players pushed their money onto red. They reasoned that after so many blacks, red was surely 'due'. By the end of the evening, the casino had collected millions of francs from them. The players had fallen into what is now called the gambler's fallacy, the belief that the past results of a random process change the chances of future ones. A roulette wheel, however, has no memory. On every spin, the probability of black stays slightly below one half, whatever happened before. A run of twenty-six blacks is extremely unlikely if someone predicts it in advance, yet among the millions of spins that take place in casinos every year, some long runs are bound to appear somewhere. Psychologists suggest that the fallacy arises because people expect even short sequences to look like the overall pattern. We know that a fair wheel produces roughly equal numbers of red and black in the long run, so we wrongly assume that it must 'correct' itself quickly. The same error appears far from casinos. Parents who have had three sons may feel that a daughter is now more likely, and some investors sell a share simply because its price has risen for several days in a row.
exercises.question: Parçanın ana fikri aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
options: Casinos replace their roulette wheels whenever a long run of one colour appears.
People often wrongly believe that earlier random results affect the chances of later ones.
Long runs of the same colour are impossible on a fair roulette wheel.
Investors are generally better than gamblers at judging probability.
Most parents would prefer to have children of both sexes.
exercises.explanation: Parça 1913’teki olaydan yola çıkarak ‘kumarbaz yanılgısını’, yani önceki rastgele sonuçların sonrakileri etkilediği yanlış inancını anlatır: ‘People often wrongly believe …’. Rulet çarkının değiştirildiğinden (‘replace’) söz edilmez; uzun serilerin imkânsız (‘impossible’) olmadığı açıkça söylenir; yatırımcılar (‘Investors’) ve ebeveynler (‘parents’) yalnızca örnek olarak geçer.

exercises.question: According to the passage, why did the players bet more and more on red?
options: They noticed that the wheel had been damaged during the evening.
The casino offered them better prizes for betting on red.
They had been told by other players that the game was unfair.
Red had come up more often than black earlier that night.
They believed that red had to come up soon after so many blacks.
exercises.explanation: Parçada oyuncuların ‘bu kadar siyahtan sonra kırmızının artık gelmesi gerektiğini’ düşündükleri söylenir: ‘They believed that red had to come up soon …’. Çarkın hasar gördüğü (‘damaged’), kumarhanenin daha iyi ödül (‘prizes’) verdiği ya da oyunun hileli (‘unfair’) olduğu söylenmez; o gece kırmızının daha sık geldiği (‘earlier’) bilgisi de metinle çelişir.

exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that the casino ----.
options: tried to stop the players from betting on red
benefited from the players' mistaken reasoning
lost a large amount of money that night
had arranged the long run of blacks in advance
closed the table after the twentieth spin
exercises.explanation: Oyuncular kırmızıya oynadı, siyah gelmeye devam etti ve kumarhane ‘milyonlarca frank topladı’; demek ki oyuncuların yanlış akıl yürütmesinden kazançlı çıktı: ‘benefited from the players' mistaken reasoning’. exercises.question: The author mentions parents and investors in the last part of the passage in order to ----.
options: prove that psychologists disagree about the gambler’s fallacy
warn readers against investing their money in shares
explain why the Monte Carlo Casino became so famous
compare the chances of having a son and a daughter
show that the same error also occurs in everyday decisions
exercises.explanation: Yazar ‘The same error appears far from casinos’ dedikten sonra ebeveyn ve yatırımcı örneklerini verir; amaç yanılgının günlük kararlarda da görüldüğünü göstermektir: ‘show that the same error also occurs …’. Psikologların anlaşmazlığı (‘disagree’), hisse senedine karşı uyarı (‘warn’), kumarhanenin ünü (‘famous’) ya da kız-erkek olasılıklarını karşılaştırma (‘compare’) amaçlanmaz.

exercises.passage: Imagine taking the populations of every town in a country, or the prices of all the products in a large shop, and writing down only the first digit of each number. Most people would expect each digit from 1 to 9 to appear about equally often. In fact, in many real collections of data, the digit 1 comes first about 30 per cent of the time, while 9 leads in fewer than 5 per cent of cases. This pattern was first noticed by the astronomer Simon Newcomb in 1881, who saw that the early pages of his books of logarithm tables were far more worn than the later ones. It was rediscovered by the engineer Frank Benford in 1938 and now carries his name. The pattern appears mainly in data that grow by multiplication and cover several orders of magnitude, such as the lengths of rivers or the incomes of companies. It does not apply to numbers that are limited to a narrow range, like the heights of adults, or to numbers that are assigned by people, like telephone numbers. Benford's law has found a surprisingly practical use. When people invent figures, for example on a false tax return, they tend to spread the first digits too evenly, because they believe that this looks random. Tax inspectors and auditors therefore compare the digits in suspicious accounts with the expected pattern. A large difference does not prove that anyone has cheated, but it suggests which files deserve a closer look.
exercises.question: What is the passage mainly about?
options: an unexpected pattern in first digits and how it helps to identify invented figures
the life and scientific career of the astronomer Simon Newcomb
the reasons why telephone numbers are assigned at random
a new method that tax inspectors use to calculate income tax
the difficulty of measuring the exact lengths of rivers
exercises.explanation: Parça ilk basamaklardaki beklenmedik dağılımı (Benford yasası) ve uydurma rakamları ortaya çıkarmadaki kullanımını anlatır: ‘an unexpected pattern in first digits …’. Newcomb’un hayatı (‘career’), telefon numaraları (‘telephone’), vergi hesaplama yöntemi (‘calculate’) ve nehir ölçümü (‘measuring’) yalnızca ayrıntı ya da örnek olarak geçer veya hiç işlenmez.

options: he had counted the first digits of thousands of town populations
Frank Benford had sent him a list of company incomes
the first pages of his logarithm books were more worn than the last ones
his telephone number began with the digit 1

The pattern appears mainly in data that grow by multiplication and cover several orders of magnitude, such as the lengths of rivers or the incomes of companies. It does not apply to numbers that are limited to a narrow range, like the heights of adults, or to numbers that are assigned by people, like telephone numbers. Benford's law has found a surprisingly practical use. When people invent figures, for example on a false tax return, they tend to spread the first digits too evenly, because they believe that this looks random. Tax inspectors and auditors therefore compare the digits in suspicious accounts with the expected pattern. A large difference does not prove that anyone has cheated, but it suggests which files deserve a closer look.
exercises.question: Which of the following would NOT be expected to follow Benford's law?
options: the heights of adult men in a city
the lengths of the world’s rivers
the yearly incomes of large companies
the populations of towns in a country
the prices of products in a large shop
exercises.explanation: Parça, dar bir aralıkla sınırlı sayıların, örneğin yetişkin boylarının, bu yasaya uymadığını söyler: ‘the heights of adult men in a city’. Nehir uzunlukları (‘rivers’), şirket gelirleri (‘incomes’), kasaba nüfusları (‘populations’) ve mağaza fiyatları (‘prices’) ise yasaya uyan veri örnekleri olarak verilmiştir.

exercises.passage: Imagine taking the populations of every town in a country, or the prices of all the products in a large shop, and writing down only the first digit of each number. Most people would expect each digit from 1 to 9 to appear about equally often. In fact, in many real collections of data, the digit 1 comes first about 30 per cent of the time, while 9 leads in fewer than 5 per cent of cases. This pattern was first noticed by the astronomer Simon Newcomb in 1881, who saw that the early pages of his books of logarithm tables were far more worn than the later ones. It was rediscovered by the engineer Frank Benford in 1938 and now carries his name. The pattern appears mainly in data that grow by multiplication and cover several orders of magnitude, such as the lengths of rivers or the incomes of companies. It does not apply to numbers that are limited to a narrow range, like the heights of adults, or to numbers that are assigned by people, like telephone numbers. Benford's law has found a surprisingly practical use. When people invent figures, for example on a false tax return, they tend to spread the first digits too evenly, because they believe that this looks random. Tax inspectors and auditors therefore compare the digits in suspicious accounts with the expected pattern. A large difference does not prove that anyone has cheated, but it suggests which files deserve a closer look.
exercises.question: It can be understood from the passage that people who invent numbers ----.
options: usually choose numbers that begin with the digit 1
are always caught by tax inspectors in the end
know the pattern described by Benford very well
prefer numbers that cover several orders of magnitude
often produce first digits that are more evenly spread than real data
exercises.explanation: Parçaya göre rakam uyduranlar, rastgele göründüğünü sanarak ilk basamakları fazla eşit dağıtır: ‘more evenly spread than real data’. 1 ile başlayan sayıları seçtikleri (‘begin’) söylenmez; her zaman yakalandıkları (‘always caught’) metinle çelişir, çünkü fark kanıt değildir; yasayı iyi bildikleri (‘know’) ya da büyüklük basamaklarını tercih ettikleri (‘prefer’) de çıkarılamaz.

exercises.passage: Imagine taking the populations of every town in a country, or the prices of all the products in a large shop, and writing down only the first digit of each number. Most people would expect each digit from 1 to 9 to appear about equally often. In fact, in many real collections of data, the digit 1 comes first about 30 per cent of the time, while 9 leads in fewer than 5 per cent of cases. This pattern was first noticed by the astronomer Simon Newcomb in 1881, who saw that the early pages of his books of logarithm tables were far more worn than the later ones. It was rediscovered by the engineer Frank Benford in 1938 and now carries his name. The pattern appears mainly in data that grow by multiplication and cover several orders of magnitude, such as the lengths of rivers or the incomes of companies. It does not apply to numbers that are limited to a narrow range, like the heights of adults, or to numbers that are assigned by people, like telephone numbers. Benford's law has found a surprisingly practical use. When people invent figures, for example on a false tax return, they tend to spread the first digits too evenly, because they believe that this looks random. Tax inspectors and auditors therefore compare the digits in suspicious accounts with the expected pattern. A large difference does not prove that anyone has cheated, but it suggests which files deserve a closer look.
exercises.question: The author's attitude towards using Benford's law in tax inspections can best be described as ----.
options: strongly critical, because the law rarely applies to financial data
enthusiastic, since the law proves that cheating has taken place
doubtful, because inspectors do not understand how the law works
cautiously positive, since a mismatch is a warning sign rather than proof
indifferent, as the passage expresses no view on its usefulness
exercises.explanation: Yazar yöntemi ‘şaşırtıcı derecede pratik’ bulur ama büyük bir farkın hileyi kanıtlamadığını, yalnızca hangi dosyalara bakılacağını gösterdiğini ekler; tutumu temkinli olumludur: ‘cautiously positive …’. ‘strongly critical’ ve ‘doubtful’ olumlu ifadeyle çelişir; ‘enthusiastic … proves’ kanıt olmadığı uyarısıyla çelişir; ‘indifferent’ ise yazarın görüş bildirdiği gerçeğine uymaz.

nodes.title: Diyalog, restatement, paragraf
nodes.description: Diyalog tamamlama, yeniden ifade, paragraf tamamlama ve anlamı bozan cümle

exercises.passage:
Emre: I've just read that the chance of being struck by lightning is about one in a million every year.
Lisa: ----
Emre: True. I suppose a farmer who works outdoors all day faces a much higher risk than someone in an office.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: I was once caught in a thunderstorm during a football match.
Lightning always strikes the tallest object in the area, doesn't it?
That's only an average, though; it depends a lot on where you live and what you do.
Then I'll never go swimming during a storm again.
The newspaper probably made that figure up to sell more copies.
exercises.explanation: Emre ‘True’ diyerek dışarıda çalışan bir çiftçinin riskinin daha yüksek olduğunu ekliyor; demek ki Lisa bu rakamın yalnızca bir ortalama olduğunu ve kişinin yaşam koşullarına bağlı olduğunu söylemiştir: ‘That's only an average …’. Futbol maçı anısı (‘football’), en yüksek nesne sorusu (‘tallest’), yüzme kararı (‘swimming’) ve gazetenin uydurduğu iddiası (‘newspaper’) Emre’nin cevabına bağlanmaz.

exercises.passage:
Doctor: Your test result is positive, but please don't panic yet.
Patient: ----
Doctor: Because this test sometimes reacts to harmless proteins, about a third of positive results turn out to be false. We'll do a second test to make sure.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: When will the results of the test be ready?
Why not? Doesn't a positive result mean that I have the disease?
How much does the second test cost?
Should I stop taking my other medicine?
Who told you that I was afraid of needles?
exercises.explanation: Doktor ‘Because …’ diye neden açıklıyor ve pozitif sonuçların üçte birinin yanlış çıktığını söylüyor; hasta neden panik yapmaması gerektiğini sormuş olmalıdır: ‘Why not? Doesn't a positive result mean …’. Sonuçların ne zaman hazır olacağı (‘ready’) zaten belli; ücret (‘cost’), diğer ilaçlar (‘medicine’) ve iğne korkusu (‘needles’) doktorun cevabıyla ilgisizdir.

exercises.passage:
Kerem: According to that sports website, our team has a 70 per cent chance of winning on Sunday.
Aylin: How do they even calculate a number like that?
Kerem: ----
Aylin: So it's basically an educated guess based on history. I won't bet my lunch money on it, then.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: I'd rather watch the match at home than at the stadium.
The website was started by two former players last year.
They look at the results of past matches between similar teams and see how often the stronger side won.
Our goalkeeper was injured in training on Wednesday.
They ask every player on the team to predict the final score.
exercises.explanation: Aylin ‘geçmişe dayalı bilinçli bir tahmin’ diye özetliyor; Kerem hesaplamanın geçmiş maç sonuçlarına dayandığını söylemiş olmalıdır: ‘They look at the results of past matches …’. Maçı evde izleme isteği (‘stadium’), sitenin kuruluşu (‘former players’), kalecinin sakatlığı (‘goalkeeper’) ve oyunculara skor tahmini sordurma (‘predict’) ‘history’ özetine uymaz.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The researchers were unable to rule out the possibility that their results had occurred by chance.
options: The researchers proved that their results had not occurred by chance.
The researchers could not exclude the chance that their results were accidental.
The researchers were sure that chance alone explained their results.
It was purely by chance that the researchers found their results.
The researchers refused to repeat the study in case the results changed.
exercises.explanation: ‘rule out the possibility’ (olasılığı dışlamak) = ‘exclude the chance’; araştırmacılar sonuçların tesadüf olma ihtimalini dışlayamadı: ‘could not exclude the chance …’. ‘proved … had not occurred’ tersini, ‘were sure … alone’ fazla kesin bir yargıyı söyler; ‘purely by chance … found’ bulma eylemini tesadüfe bağlar; ‘refused to repeat’ ise metinde olmayan bir bilgidir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Hardly anyone expected the small company to survive its first year, let alone become a market leader.
options: Very few people thought the small company would last a year, and becoming a market leader seemed even less likely.
Most people believed that the small company would soon become a market leader.
The small company became a market leader in its very first year.
Nobody was surprised when the small company failed in its first year.
The small company survived its first year because it was a market leader.
exercises.explanation: ‘Hardly anyone’ = çok az kişi, ‘let alone’ = … şöyle dursun; şirketin bir yıl dayanması bile beklenmiyordu, lider olması daha da az olasıydı: ‘Very few people thought … even less likely.’ ‘Most people believed’ tersini söyler; ‘very first year’ olmayan bir başarıyı anlatır; ‘failed’ şirketin battığını iddia eder; ‘because … leader’ ise yanlış bir neden-sonuç kurar.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

But for the early warning, many more people would have been injured in the flood.
options: Although there was an early warning, many people were injured in the flood.
The early warning came too late to stop people being injured in the flood.
Many people were injured because they ignored the early warning about the flood.
Without the flood, nobody would have needed an early warning.
If there had not been an early warning, the flood would have injured far more people.
exercises.explanation: ‘But for’ = ‘If there had not been’ (… olmasaydı); erken uyarı sayesinde çok daha fazla yaralanma önlendi: ‘If there had not been an early warning …’. ‘Although’ ile kurulan seçenek uyarının işe yaramadığını, ‘too late’ uyarının geç kaldığını, ‘ignored’ insanların uyarıyı dinlemediğini, ‘Without the flood’ ise farklı bir koşulu anlatır.

exercises.passage: Airlines regularly sell more tickets than there are seats on a plane. This is not a careless mistake but a calculated decision. ---- By studying years of booking data, an airline can predict quite accurately how many no-shows to expect on a particular route and day. On the rare occasions when everyone does turn up, passengers who agree to take a later flight are offered money or travel vouchers.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Many travellers prefer window seats because they can sleep more easily.
The first commercial passenger flight took place in Florida in 1914.
Airport security checks have become much stricter in recent decades.
On most flights, a certain proportion of passengers fail to turn up, and empty seats mean lost income.
Pilots must rest for a fixed number of hours between long flights.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonraki cümle ‘no-shows’ (gelmeyen yolcular) sayısının tahmin edilmesinden söz eder; boşluk bu kavramı ve fazla bilet satmanın nedenini vermelidir: ‘On most flights, a certain proportion of passengers fail to turn up …’. Pencere kenarı tercihi (‘window’), ilk ticari uçuş (‘Florida’), güvenlik kontrolleri (‘security’) ve pilotların dinlenmesi (‘Pilots’) akışı koparır.

exercises.passage: Before a new medicine is approved, it is usually tested in a randomised controlled trial. Volunteers are divided by chance into two groups: one receives the drug, while the other receives a placebo, a pill that looks the same but contains no active substance. ---- As a result, any difference in health between the groups at the end of the trial can be attributed to the drug with reasonable confidence.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Some volunteers take part in trials mainly because they are paid for their time.
Placebos were first used by doctors centuries ago to calm anxious patients.
Many medicines are now produced in factories in several different countries.
Each volunteer is asked to keep a diary of any headaches during the trial.
Because the groups are formed randomly, factors such as age or lifestyle are likely to be spread evenly between them.
exercises.explanation: Sonraki cümle ‘As a result’ ile gruplar arasındaki farkın ilaca bağlanabileceğini söyler; bunun nedeni grupların rastgele oluşturulması sayesinde yaş ve yaşam tarzı gibi etkenlerin eşit dağılmasıdır: ‘Because the groups are formed randomly …’. Ücret (‘paid’), plaseboların tarihi (‘centuries’), ilaç üretimi (‘factories’) ve baş ağrısı günlüğü (‘diary’) bu sonucu açıklamaz.

exercises.passage: ---- For example, many people are more afraid of flying than of driving, even though, per kilometre travelled, a car journey is far more dangerous. Similarly, shark attacks receive huge media attention, while many more swimmers drown every year because of strong currents. Experts believe that dramatic, rare events stay in our memory and therefore seem more common than they really are.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Modern cars are equipped with many safety features that did not exist fifty years ago.
Sharks have lived in the world’s oceans for more than 400 million years.
Most airlines publish detailed figures about delays on their websites.
Our sense of which dangers are the most serious often has little to do with the real statistics.
Swimming is one of the best forms of exercise for people of all ages.
exercises.explanation: Boşluk paragrafın başıdır ve ‘For example’ ile gelen örnekleri (uçak/araba, köpek balığı/akıntı) kapsayan genel fikri vermelidir: tehlike algımız gerçek istatistiklerle pek örtüşmez. Araba güvenliği (‘equipped’), köpek balıklarının tarihi (‘million’), havayolu rötarları (‘delays’) ve yüzmenin faydası (‘exercise’) bu örnekleri bağlamaz.

exercises.passage: (I) Flood insurance is priced according to how likely a property is to be flooded. (II) Insurers use detailed maps that combine information about rainfall, river levels and the height of the land. (III) Homes close to a river or on low ground therefore pay much higher premiums than those on hills. (IV) Many people enjoy living near water because of the peaceful views it offers. (V) In some areas the risk is so high that private companies refuse to offer cover at all, and the government has to step in.
exercises.question: Paragrafta anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
options: I
II
III
IV
V
exercises.explanation: Paragraf sel sigortasının fiyatının riske göre nasıl belirlendiğini anlatır: (I) risk ölçütü, (II) haritalar, (III) yüksek primler, (V) riskin çok yüksek olduğu bölgeler. (IV) ise suya yakın yaşamanın manzara açısından keyfini anlatır; konu aynı (suya yakın evler) ama sigorta fiyatıyla ilgisi yoktur, bu yüzden akışı bozar.

exercises.passage: (I) Most dice sold for board games today are made of plastic and come in many bright colours. (II) For a die to be fair, each of its faces must have the same chance of landing on top. (III) This requires the cube to be perfectly shaped and its weight to be evenly spread. (IV) Cheats have long exploited this by hiding small weights inside dice so that certain numbers appear more often. (V) Casinos therefore use transparent dice made to very precise measurements, which makes such tricks easy to spot.
exercises.question: Paragrafta anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
options: I
II
III
IV
V
exercises.explanation: (II)–(V) cümleleri bir zarın adil olması için gereken koşulları ve bunun hileyle nasıl bozulduğunu anlatır: (II) eşit şans, (III) biçim ve ağırlık, (IV) ağırlıklı zarlar, (V) şeffaf zarlar. (I) ise zarların neyden yapıldığı ve rengiyle ilgilidir; zar konusunda kalır ama adalet ve hile akışına bağlanmaz, bu yüzden akışı bozan cümle (I)’dir.

nodes.title: Ünite testi
nodes.description: 15 karışık soru; geçmek için %80 doğru yap

exercises.question: The study was criticised because its sample was too small to allow any reliable ---- about the whole population.
options: generalisation
specimen
footnote
appendix
manuscript
exercises.explanation: Küçük örneklemden bütün nüfus hakkında güvenilir bir ‘genelleme’ yapılamaz; doğru kelime ‘generalisation’. ‘specimen’ (numune), ‘footnote’ (dipnot), ‘appendix’ (ek) ve ‘manuscript’ (el yazması/taslak) ‘about the whole population’ ile anlamlı bir bütün oluşturmaz.

exercises.question: Although the two laboratories used ---- methods, they produced strikingly different results.
options: vague
identical
obscure
residual
implicit
exercises.explanation: ‘Although’ zıtlık kurar: yöntemler aynı olduğu hâlde sonuçlar çok farklıydı; doğru kelime ‘identical’ (özdeş). ‘vague’ (belirsiz), ‘obscure’ (anlaşılmaz), ‘residual’ (artık, kalıntı) ve ‘implicit’ (örtük) farklı sonuçlarla bir zıtlık oluşturmaz.

exercises.question: Not until the data ---- by an independent team did anyone notice the error in the calculation.
options: re-examined
had re-examining
were re-examined
were re-examining
re-examine
exercises.explanation: Veriler kendileri incelemez, incelenir; bu yüzden edilgen ve geçmiş zaman ‘were re-examined’ gerekir (ana cümle ‘did anyone notice’ geçmiştir). ‘re-examined’ ve ‘re-examine’ etken çatıdır, ‘were re-examining’ verileri inceleyen yapar, ‘had re-examining’ ise dilbilgisi açısından yanlıştır.

exercises.question: The ethics committee insisted that every result ---- by at least two independent researchers before publication.
options: is checking
checks
to be checked
be checked
having checked
exercises.explanation: ‘insist that’ gibi talep bildiren fiillerden sonra subjunctive (yalın fiil) kullanılır; sonuç kontrol edileceği için edilgen ‘be checked’ doğrudur. ‘is checking’ ve ‘checks’ sonucu kontrol eden yapar, ‘to be checked’ ve ‘having checked’ çekimsiz biçimlerdir ve that-cümlesinin yüklemi olamaz.

exercises.question: No matter how carefully a forecast is made, ----.
options: because the computers used for it are very powerful
the forecasters who had made it the previous week
it can only express how likely an outcome is, not whether it will happen
so it was never published in the newspapers
unless the weather had been unusually calm
exercises.explanation: ‘No matter how carefully’ (ne kadar dikkatli yapılırsa yapılsın) bir sınırlama gerektirir: tahmin yalnızca olasılığı söyleyebilir, ‘it can only express how likely an outcome is’. ‘computers … powerful’ neden bildirir ve tamamlanmamış kalır; ‘forecasters who had made it’ yüklemsiz bir isim öbeğidir; ‘never published’ ve ‘unusually calm’ seçenekleri ise anlam ve zaman uyumunu bozar.

exercises.question: ----, the researchers decided to repeat the survey with a larger and more varied sample.
options: Unless the first results had been surprising
Even though the original sample was clearly far too small
So that the questionnaire would take less time
Whose answers had been collected online
Concerned that their first sample might not represent the whole population
exercises.explanation: Araştırmacılar ilk örneklemin nüfusu temsil etmeyebileceğinden endişe ettikleri için anketi daha büyük örneklemle tekrarladılar: ‘Concerned that their first sample might not represent …’. ‘Unless … surprising’ zaman uyumsuz bir koşul, ‘Even though … small’ mantıksız bir zıtlık, ‘questionnaire … less time’ büyük örneklemle çelişen bir amaçtır; ‘Whose answers’ ise bağlanacak bir isim bulamaz.

exercises.question:
Verilen İngilizce cümlenin Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?

Little is known about how likely such an event is, since it has been observed only a handful of times.
options: Böyle bir olay çok sık gözlemlendiği için olasılığı hakkında çok şey bilinmektedir.
Böyle bir olayın ne kadar olası olduğu hakkında çok az şey bilinmektedir, çünkü yalnızca birkaç kez gözlemlenmiştir.
Böyle bir olayın olasılığı küçük olsa da birçok kez gözlemlenmiştir.
Böyle bir olayın birkaç kez gözlemlenmesi, olasılığının çok düşük olduğunu kanıtlar.
Böyle olaylar nadiren gözlemlendiğinden bilim insanları onlarla ilgilenmez.
exercises.explanation: ‘Little is known’ = çok az şey bilinmektedir, ‘since’ = çünkü, ‘only a handful of times’ = yalnızca birkaç kez: ‘… çok az şey bilinmektedir, çünkü yalnızca birkaç kez gözlemlenmiştir.’ ‘sık … çok şey’ anlamı tersine çevirir; ‘küçük olsa da birçok’ zıtlık ve sayı hatası yapar; ‘kanıtlar’ metinde olmayan bir sonuç çıkarır; ‘ilgilenmez’ ise farklı bir yargı ekler.

exercises.question:
Verilen Türkçe cümlenin İngilizce karşılığı hangisidir?

Sonuçlar ne kadar umut verici olursa olsun, çalışma tekrarlanmadan genelleştirilmemelidir.
options: However promising the results may be, the study should not be generalised before it is replicated.
Because the results are so promising, the study does not need to be replicated.
The results were promising, so the study was generalised after it had been replicated.
If the results are not promising, the study should be replicated before it is published.
Although the study was replicated, its promising results could not be generalised.
exercises.explanation: ‘ne kadar … olursa olsun’ = ‘However … may be’, ‘tekrarlanmadan genelleştirilmemelidir’ = ‘should not be generalised before it is replicated’. ‘does not need’ tekrarı gereksiz sayar; ‘was generalised after’ gerçekleşmiş bir olay anlatır; ‘If … not promising’ koşulu değiştirir; ‘Although … could not’ ise geçmişe ait farklı bir durum anlatır.

exercises.passage: Clinical trials are designed to detect the common side effects of a new drug, but they rarely include more than a few thousand volunteers. A side effect that affects one patient in fifty thousand is therefore unlikely to appear before the drug is approved. For this reason, regulators continue to collect reports from doctors after a medicine reaches the market, and in rare cases a drug is withdrawn years after its approval.
exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that ----.
options: clinical trials are designed mainly to find extremely rare side effects
very rare side effects are usually discovered only after a drug is in wide use
most drugs are withdrawn from the market a few years after approval
doctors are not allowed to report side effects once a drug is approved
trials with a few thousand volunteers detect every possible side effect
exercises.explanation: Denemeler birkaç bin kişiyle yapıldığı için elli binde bir görülen yan etki onaydan önce ortaya çıkmaz; bu yüzden çok nadir yan etkiler genellikle ilaç yaygın kullanıma girdikten sonra fark edilir: ‘very rare side effects are usually discovered only after …’. Denemelerin nadir etkiler için tasarlandığı (‘extremely’), ilaçların çoğunun geri çekildiği (‘most drugs’), doktorların bildirim yapamadığı (‘allowed’) ya da her etkinin bulunduğu (‘every possible’) metinle çelişir.

exercises.passage: Clinical trials are designed to detect the common side effects of a new drug, but they rarely include more than a few thousand volunteers. A side effect that affects one patient in fifty thousand is therefore unlikely to appear before the drug is approved. For this reason, regulators continue to collect reports from doctors after a medicine reaches the market, and in rare cases a drug is withdrawn years after its approval.
exercises.question: According to the passage, regulators keep collecting reports after a drug is approved because ----.
options: trials are too small to reveal side effects that occur very rarely
doctors often forget to test new drugs before approval
volunteers in trials usually hide their side effects
common side effects only appear after several years
most patients stop taking a drug soon after it is approved
exercises.explanation: Parça ‘For this reason’ ile bağlar: denemeler küçük olduğu için çok nadir yan etkiler onaydan önce görülmez, bu yüzden raporlar toplanmaya devam eder: ‘trials are too small to reveal …’. Doktorların test etmeyi unuttuğu (‘forget’), gönüllülerin yan etkileri sakladığı (‘hide’), yaygın etkilerin yıllar sonra çıktığı (‘common’) ya da hastaların ilacı bıraktığı (‘stop’) söylenmez.

exercises.passage:
Nurse: You'll need to wait here for thirty minutes after the vaccine before you leave.
Man: ----
Nurse: Serious reactions are very rare, but when they do happen, they usually start within that time, so we like to be able to treat them immediately.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Where can I buy a ticket for the car park?
How many vaccines have you given today?
Is that really necessary? I feel perfectly fine.
Will this vaccine protect me for the rest of my life?
Could you tell me the name of this vaccine?
exercises.explanation: Hemşire neden beklemek gerektiğini açıklıyor (ciddi tepkiler o sürede başlar); demek ki adam beklemenin gerçekten gerekli olup olmadığını sormuştur: ‘Is that really necessary? I feel perfectly fine.’ Otopark bileti (‘car park’), günlük aşı sayısı (‘today’), ömür boyu koruma (‘rest of my life’) ve aşının adı (‘name’) hemşirenin cevabıyla örtüşmez.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

So unlikely was the outcome that even the experts who had predicted it were astonished when it actually occurred.
options: The experts were not surprised by the outcome because they had predicted it.
Only the experts believed that such an unlikely outcome would never occur.
The experts predicted the outcome after it had actually occurred.
The outcome was so improbable that the experts who had forecast it were amazed when it really happened.
Although the outcome was likely, the experts had failed to predict it.
exercises.explanation: Devrik ‘So unlikely was the outcome that …’ = sonuç o kadar olasılık dışıydı ki onu öngören uzmanlar bile şaşırdı: ‘… so improbable that the experts who had forecast it were amazed …’. ‘not surprised’ tersini söyler; ‘would never occur’ uzmanların öngörüsünü yok sayar; ‘after it had actually occurred’ sırayı bozar; ‘Although … likely’ ise olasılığı ve öngörüyü tersine çevirir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Were the two events entirely unconnected, we would not expect them to occur together so often.
options: Because the two events are unconnected, they rarely happen at the same time.
The two events would happen together more often if they were connected.
We expected the two events to occur together, but they were unconnected.
Since the two events often occur together, they must have been caused by chance.
If the two events had nothing to do with each other, it would be surprising that they happen together so frequently.
exercises.explanation: Devrik ‘Were the two events … unconnected’ = ‘If the two events had nothing to do with each other’; bağımsız olsalardı bu kadar sık birlikte görülmeleri beklenmezdi. ‘rarely happen’ gerçek durumu tersine çevirir; ‘more often if they were connected’ koşulu değiştirir; ‘We expected’ farklı bir beklenti anlatır; ‘caused by chance’ ise cümlenin sonucuna tamamen ters düşer.

exercises.passage: Suppose a disease affects one person in a thousand, and a test for it is 99 per cent accurate. If you test positive, it seems natural to conclude that you almost certainly have the disease. ---- Among a thousand people tested, about ten healthy people will receive a false positive, while only one person actually has the disease. In other words, most positive results will be wrong.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Surprisingly, however, the real probability is less than ten per cent.
This is why doctors always recommend a healthy diet and regular exercise.
The first reliable blood tests were developed at the beginning of the last century.
Unfortunately, the disease cannot yet be cured with any existing medicine.
Therefore, the test should be used only on people who already feel ill.
exercises.explanation: Önceki cümle ‘doğal olarak’ hasta olduğunuzu düşüneceğinizi söyler; sonraki cümleler pozitif sonuçların çoğunun yanlış olduğunu hesaplar. Aradaki boşluk bu beklentiyi ‘however’ ile çürütmelidir: ‘Surprisingly, however, the real probability is less than ten per cent.’ Sağlıklı beslenme (‘diet’), testlerin tarihi (‘century’), tedavinin olmaması (‘cured’) ve testin yalnızca hastalara uygulanması (‘feel ill’) hesaplamaya geçişi sağlamaz.

exercises.passage: (I) Thomas Bayes was an eighteenth-century English minister with a strong interest in mathematics. (II) His most important idea was a method for updating the probability of a belief when new evidence becomes available. (III) The Royal Society, founded in 1660, is one of the oldest scientific academies in the world. (IV) Strangely, Bayes never published this work himself; it was found among his papers after his death and sent to the Royal Society by a friend. (V) Today, his method is used in fields as different as spam filtering, medical diagnosis and the search for lost ships.
exercises.question: Paragrafta anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
options: I
II
III
IV
V
exercises.explanation: Paragraf Thomas Bayes’i ve yöntemini anlatır: (I) kim olduğu, (II) fikri, (IV) çalışmasının ölümünden sonra yayımlanması, (V) bugünkü kullanım alanları. (III) ise Royal Society’nin kuruluş tarihini ve yaşını anlatır; (IV)’te bu kurum geçse de Bayes’in hayatı ve yöntemiyle ilgisi yoktur, akışı bozar.

nodes.title: Ünite ödülü
nodes.description: Üniteyi bitir, bonus XP kazan

nodes.title: Yarım deneme 3
nodes.description: YDS dağılımında 40 soru, 90 dakika (B1+–B2). Planın 24. haftasındaki yarım deneme; sonucunu önceki denemelerle karşılaştır.

exercises.question: Although the evidence for the herbal remedy is largely ----, consisting mostly of personal stories told by satisfied patients, its sales have grown rapidly over the past few years.
options: systematic
credible
quantitative
anecdotal
comparable
exercises.explanation: Kanıtın çoğunlukla hastaların kişisel öykülerinden oluştuğu söylendiğinden ‘anecdotal’ (kişisel anlatıya dayalı, bilimsel olmayan) doğrudur; ‘Although’ da zayıf kanıta rağmen satışların arttığı zıtlığını kurar. ‘systematic’ (sistemli) ve ‘quantitative’ (nicel) kişisel öykülerle çelişir; ‘credible’ (inandırıcı) zıtlığı ortadan kaldırır; ‘comparable’ (karşılaştırılabilir) ise anlam kurmaz.

exercises.question: Under the new law, which comes into effect next year, it will be illegal to sell certain pesticides that scientists have linked to the sharp decline in bee populations, so the government will effectively ---- their use.
options: prohibit
inspire
accompany
resemble
encounter
exercises.explanation: Satışı yasa dışı olacak ilaçların kullanımı fiilen yasaklanmış olur: ‘prohibit’ (yasaklamak). ‘inspire’ (esin vermek) ve ‘accompany’ (eşlik etmek) yasakla ilgisizdir; ‘resemble’ (benzemek) ve ‘encounter’ (karşılaşmak) da ‘their use’ nesnesiyle anlamlı bir yasa hükmü kurmaz.

exercises.question: In the desert, the temperature ---- dramatically between day and night, sometimes falling by more than thirty degrees within a few hours of sunset.
options: accumulates
converges
fluctuates
culminates
dissolves
exercises.explanation: Gündüz ile gece arasında sıcaklığın büyük ölçüde inip çıkması ‘fluctuates’ (dalgalanmak) ile anlatılır; ‘falling by more than thirty degrees’ bunu destekler. ‘accumulates’ (birikmek) ve ‘converges’ (bir noktada birleşmek) iniş çıkış bildirmez; ‘culminates’ (doruğa ulaşmak) ‘in’ ister; ‘dissolves’ (çözünmek) sıcaklık için kullanılmaz.

exercises.question: The fragments of ancient cloth discovered in a dry cave in northern Peru ---- that cotton was being woven in the region more than 5,000 years ago.
options: suggesting
suggest
which suggest
to suggest
having suggested
exercises.explanation: Cümlenin öznesi ‘The fragments of ancient cloth’ dır; ‘discovered in a dry cave …’ onu niteleyen bir sıfat-fiil grubudur, bu yüzden boşluğa çekimli ana fiil gerekir: ‘suggest’. ‘suggesting’ ve ‘having suggested’ çekimsiz fiilimsilerdir; ‘which suggest’ cümleyi ana fiilsiz bir yan cümleye çevirir; ‘to suggest’ de tek başına yüklem olamaz.

exercises.question: By the time the rescue team finally reached the flooded village, most of the residents ---- to higher ground with the help of their neighbours.
options: moved
have moved
are moving
would move
had already moved
exercises.explanation: ‘By the time … reached’ geçmişteki bir andan önce tamamlanmış bir eylemi gerektirir, bu da ‘had already moved’ (çoktan taşınmışlardı) ile anlatılır. ‘moved’ eylemleri sıralı gösterir ve öncelik bildirmez; ‘have moved’ ve ‘are moving’ şimdiki zamana aittir; ‘would move’ ise geçmişte gelecek anlamı verir.

exercises.question: If the farmers had been warned about the frost a few days earlier, they ---- their crops by covering them with plastic sheets.
options: could have protected
can protect
had protected
will have protected
would protect
exercises.explanation: ‘If … had been warned’ geçmişe dönük gerçek dışı koşuldur (üçüncü tip); sonuç kısmı ‘could/would have + V3’ ister: ‘could have protected’. ‘can protect’ ve ‘will have protected’ gerçek koşul yapılarıdır; ‘had protected’ koşul cümlesinin yapısını tekrarlar; ‘would protect’ ise şimdiki zamana ait bir sonuç bildirir.

exercises.question: ---- its small size, the new robot is able to lift objects that are three times heavier than itself.
options: Although
Because of
Unless
Despite
As long as
exercises.explanation: Küçük boyuta rağmen ağır cisimleri kaldırabilmesi bir zıtlıktır ve boşluktan sonra bir isim öbeği (‘its small size’) gelir; bu yüzden ‘Despite’ doğrudur. ‘Although’ zıtlık bildirse de ardından tam cümle ister; ‘Because of’ neden bildirir ve anlamca uymaz; ‘Unless’ ve ‘As long as’ koşul bağlaçlarıdır ve cümle ister.

exercises.question: The linguist ---- research on early language development has been widely cited was invited to give the opening lecture at the conference.
options: who
whom
whose
which
what
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonra gelen ‘research’ dilbilimciye aittir (dilbilimcinin araştırması); iyelik bildiren ilgi zamiri ‘whose’ dur. ‘who’ ve ‘whom’ ardından isim değil fiil ya da özne bekler; ‘which’ insan için kullanılmaz; ‘what’ ise ilgi zamiri olarak bir ismi nitelemez.

exercises.passage: Aluminium is one of the most widely used metals in the world, yet producing it from raw ore is extremely costly. The process (1)---- huge amounts of electricity, which is why smelters are often built near cheap sources of power. Recycling, by contrast, uses only about five percent of the energy needed to make new metal, (2)---- the metal does not lose its quality no matter how many times it is melted down. (3)----, a drinks can that is thrown into a recycling bin can be back on a supermarket shelf as a new can within about two months. Despite these advantages, recycling rates vary widely between countries. In some places, deposit schemes, under which consumers are paid a small sum for every empty can they (4)----, have pushed rates above ninety percent. Elsewhere, millions of tonnes of aluminium are still buried in landfill each year, (5)---- a valuable resource is simply wasted.
exercises.question: (1) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
options: preserves
resembles
postpones
withdraws
consumes
exercises.explanation: Alüminyum üretimi çok pahalıdır ve fabrikalar ucuz enerji kaynaklarının yakınına kurulur; demek ki süreç çok elektrik tüketir: ‘consumes’. ‘preserves’ (korumak) ve ‘postpones’ (ertelemek) elektrikle anlamlı bir ilişki kurmaz; ‘resembles’ (benzemek) ‘huge amounts of electricity’ ile uyuşmaz; ‘withdraws’ (geri çekmek) de bağlama uymaz.

exercises.passage: Aluminium is one of the most widely used metals in the world, yet producing it from raw ore is extremely costly. The process (1)---- huge amounts of electricity, which is why smelters are often built near cheap sources of power. Recycling, by contrast, uses only about five percent of the energy needed to make new metal, (2)---- the metal does not lose its quality no matter how many times it is melted down. (3)----, a drinks can that is thrown into a recycling bin can be back on a supermarket shelf as a new can within about two months. Despite these advantages, recycling rates vary widely between countries. In some places, deposit schemes, under which consumers are paid a small sum for every empty can they (4)----, have pushed rates above ninety percent. Elsewhere, millions of tonnes of aluminium are still buried in landfill each year, (5)---- a valuable resource is simply wasted.
exercises.question: (2) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
options: unless
and
so that
as though
in case
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan önce ve sonra geri dönüşümün iki ayrı üstünlüğü sayılır: az enerji kullanması ve metalin kalitesini yitirmemesi; bunları ekleme bağlacı ‘and’ bağlar. ‘unless’ koşul, ‘so that’ amaç, ‘in case’ önlem bildirir; ‘as though’ (sanki) ise iki gerçek bilgiyi bağlamaz.

exercises.passage: Aluminium is one of the most widely used metals in the world, yet producing it from raw ore is extremely costly. The process (1)---- huge amounts of electricity, which is why smelters are often built near cheap sources of power. Recycling, by contrast, uses only about five percent of the energy needed to make new metal, (2)---- the metal does not lose its quality no matter how many times it is melted down. (3)----, a drinks can that is thrown into a recycling bin can be back on a supermarket shelf as a new can within about two months. Despite these advantages, recycling rates vary widely between countries. In some places, deposit schemes, under which consumers are paid a small sum for every empty can they (4)----, have pushed rates above ninety percent. Elsewhere, millions of tonnes of aluminium are still buried in landfill each year, (5)---- a valuable resource is simply wasted.
exercises.question: (3) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
options: However
Nevertheless
On the contrary
For instance
Otherwise
exercises.explanation: İçecek kutusunun iki ay içinde yeniden rafa dönmesi, metalin kolayca ve tekrar tekrar geri dönüştürülebildiğine verilen bir örnektir: ‘For instance’. ‘However’ ve ‘Nevertheless’ zıtlık bildirir, oysa cümle öncekini destekler; ‘On the contrary’ önceki fikri reddeder; ‘Otherwise’ (aksi takdirde) de anlamca uymaz.

exercises.passage: Aluminium is one of the most widely used metals in the world, yet producing it from raw ore is extremely costly. The process (1)---- huge amounts of electricity, which is why smelters are often built near cheap sources of power. Recycling, by contrast, uses only about five percent of the energy needed to make new metal, (2)---- the metal does not lose its quality no matter how many times it is melted down. (3)----, a drinks can that is thrown into a recycling bin can be back on a supermarket shelf as a new can within about two months. Despite these advantages, recycling rates vary widely between countries. In some places, deposit schemes, under which consumers are paid a small sum for every empty can they (4)----, have pushed rates above ninety percent. Elsewhere, millions of tonnes of aluminium are still buried in landfill each year, (5)---- a valuable resource is simply wasted.
exercises.question: (4) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
options: return
consume
borrow
exceed
invest
exercises.explanation: Depozito sisteminde tüketiciler geri getirdikleri her boş kutu için para alır: ‘return’ (geri vermek). ‘consume’ (tüketmek) boş kutu için anlamsızdır; ‘borrow’ (ödünç almak) ve ‘invest’ (yatırım yapmak) depozito düzenini anlatmaz; ‘exceed’ (aşmak) da ‘every empty can’ nesnesiyle anlam kurmaz.

exercises.passage: Aluminium is one of the most widely used metals in the world, yet producing it from raw ore is extremely costly. The process (1)---- huge amounts of electricity, which is why smelters are often built near cheap sources of power. Recycling, by contrast, uses only about five percent of the energy needed to make new metal, (2)---- the metal does not lose its quality no matter how many times it is melted down. (3)----, a drinks can that is thrown into a recycling bin can be back on a supermarket shelf as a new can within about two months. Despite these advantages, recycling rates vary widely between countries. In some places, deposit schemes, under which consumers are paid a small sum for every empty can they (4)----, have pushed rates above ninety percent. Elsewhere, millions of tonnes of aluminium are still buried in landfill each year, (5)---- a valuable resource is simply wasted.
exercises.question: (5) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
options: even though
so that
which means that
in case
as if
exercises.explanation: Milyonlarca ton alüminyumun çöpe gömülmesinin sonucu değerli bir kaynağın boşa gitmesidir; önceki cümlenin tamamını niteleyip sonucu bildiren ‘which means that’ doğrudur. ‘even though’ zıtlık kurar ama iki bilgi çelişmez; ‘so that’ bir amaç bildirir, oysa israf kimsenin amacı değildir; ‘in case’ önlem, ‘as if’ benzetme bildirir.

exercises.question: Unless the city invests in a better drainage system, ----.
options: the streets will continue to flood after every heavy storm
the number of floods has fallen sharply over the past decade
because the old pipes were installed more than a century ago
which is why residents have stopped complaining about the problem
the new system had already been completed before the rainy season
exercises.explanation: ‘Unless’ ile kurulan gerçek koşul cümlesi gelecek zamanlı bir ana cümle ister: daha iyi bir sistem kurulmazsa sokaklar her fırtınada su basmaya devam edecek (‘the streets will continue to flood …’). ‘has fallen sharply’ zaman ve anlam bakımından uymaz; ‘because’ ve ‘which is why’ ile başlayanlar ana cümle değildir; ‘had already been completed’ ise geçmişte tamamlanmış bir işi anlatır ve koşulla çelişir.

exercises.question: ----, the number of people who rely on public transport in the city has risen steadily.
options: Unless ticket prices are reduced in the near future
Had the government invested in more roads instead
So that fewer cars would be needed in the city centre
Since the new metro line opened five years ago
Even if the buses had been far less crowded
exercises.explanation: Ana cümledeki ‘has risen’ geçmişte başlayıp süren bir durumu anlatır; ‘Since’ ile başlayan zaman bildiren yan cümle bu yapıya uyar: ‘Since the new metro line opened five years ago’. ‘Unless … reduced’ gelecek koşul bildirir; ‘Had the government invested’ gerçek dışı geçmiş koşul olduğundan ‘would have’ ister; ‘So that’ amaç bildirir ve ‘would be needed’ ile ana cümleye bağlanmaz; ‘Even if … had been’ de zaman uyumunu bozar.

exercises.question: The lecture on climate models was so technical that ----.
options: it was praised for being clear and easy to follow
whereas the previous lecture had been much simpler
because the speaker had prepared it very carefully
which is why everyone in the audience enjoyed it
many of the students could not follow the main argument
exercises.explanation: ‘so … that’ yapısı bir sonuç ister: ders o kadar tekniktir ki öğrencilerin çoğu ana savı izleyemedi (‘many of the students could not follow the main argument’). ‘praised … easy to follow’ teknik olmasıyla çelişir; ‘whereas’ ve ‘because’ ile başlayanlar sonuç bildirmez; ‘everyone … enjoyed’ ise ‘that’ yerine ‘which is why’ ile kurulduğundan yapıya uymaz.

exercises.question: Not only did the new vaccine reduce the number of serious infections, ----.
options: so hospitals had to treat many more patients
but it also shortened the time patients spent in hospital
although it was never tested on human volunteers
but the number of deaths also rose sharply
because doctors had stopped recommending it
exercises.explanation: ‘Not only … but also’ iki olumlu sonucu birlikte sunar: aşı enfeksiyonları azaltmakla kalmadı, hastanede kalış süresini de kısalttı (‘but it also shortened the time patients spent in hospital’). ‘so hospitals had to treat’ yapıya uymaz ve anlamca terstir; ‘although’ ve ‘because’ ile başlayanlar ‘but also’ yapısını tamamlamaz; ‘deaths also rose’ ise olumlu ilk bilgiyle çelişir.

exercises.question: Whereas earlier studies of children's behaviour relied mainly on questionnaires completed by parents, ----.
options: they asked the parents to describe their own feelings in writing
because the parents preferred to remain anonymous
the new study observed the children directly in the classroom
which made the results far more reliable than expected
so the researchers decided to use questionnaires as well
exercises.explanation: ‘Whereas’ iki yöntemi karşılaştırır: önceki çalışmalar anketlere dayanırken yeni çalışma çocukları doğrudan sınıfta gözlemledi (‘the new study observed the children directly in the classroom’). ‘describe their own feelings’ yine anket benzeri bir yöntem olup zıtlık kurmaz; ‘because’ ve ‘which made’ ile başlayanlar ana cümle değildir; ‘questionnaires as well’ de karşıtlığı ortadan kaldırır.

exercises.question:
Aşağıdaki İngilizce cümlenin anlamca en yakın Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?

Although the forecast had predicted only light rain, the storm that hit the coast caused serious damage to hundreds of homes.
options: Hafif yağmur beklendiği için kıyıya ulaşan fırtına yüzlerce eve yalnızca küçük zararlar verdi.
Tahmin şiddetli bir fırtına öngörmesine rağmen kıyıyı vuran yağmur yüzlerce evde ciddi hasara yol açtı.
Hava tahmini yalnızca hafif yağmur öngörmüş olsa da kıyıyı vuran fırtına yüzlerce eve ciddi zarar verdi.
Hava tahmini yalnızca hafif yağmur öngördüğü için kıyıdaki yüzlerce ev fırtınaya hazırlıksız yakalandı.
Kıyıyı vuran fırtına yüzlerce eve ciddi zarar verdikten sonra hava tahmini hafif yağmur öngördü.
exercises.explanation: ‘Although the forecast had predicted only light rain’ (hava tahmini yalnızca hafif yağmur öngörmüş olsa da) ve ‘caused serious damage to hundreds of homes’ (yüzlerce eve ciddi zarar verdi) öğeleri ‘…öngörmüş olsa da kıyıyı vuran fırtına yüzlerce eve ciddi zarar verdi.’ cümlesinde vardır. ‘küçük zararlar’ hasarı küçültür ve zıtlığı neden-sonuca çevirir; ‘şiddetli bir fırtına öngörmesine’ tahmini değiştirir; ‘hazırlıksız yakalandı’ asıl cümlede olmayan bir bilgi ekler; ‘verdikten sonra’ ise olayların sırasını bozar.

exercises.question:
Aşağıdaki Türkçe cümlenin anlamca en yakın İngilizce karşılığı hangisidir?

Bu dili ana dili olarak konuşan insanların sayısı her geçen yıl azalmasına rağmen dil hâlâ birçok okulda öğretiliyor.
options: Because the number of people who speak this language as their mother tongue is falling every year, it is no longer taught in many schools.
The language is still taught in many schools, so the number of its native speakers is rising every year.
Although the language is taught in many schools, the number of people learning it as a foreign language is falling every year.
Even if the number of native speakers of this language rises every year, it will not be taught in many schools.
Although the number of people who speak this language as their mother tongue is falling every year, it is still taught in many schools.
exercises.explanation: ‘…azalmasına rağmen’ (Although … is falling) ve ‘hâlâ birçok okulda öğretiliyor’ (it is still taught in many schools) öğelerini ‘Although the number of people who speak this language as their mother tongue is falling every year, it is still taught in many schools.’ eksiksiz verir. ‘Because … no longer taught’ zıtlığı neden-sonuca çevirip anlamı tersine döndürür; ‘rising’ sayının arttığını söyler; ‘foreign language’ ana dili yabancı dile çevirir; ‘Even if … rises’ ise varsayımsal ve ters bir anlam kurar.

exercises.question:
Aşağıdaki İngilizce cümlenin anlamca en yakın Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?

It is estimated that only about a third of the plastic collected for recycling is actually turned into new products.
options: Geri dönüşüm için toplanan plastiğin yalnızca üçte birinin gerçekten yeni ürünlere dönüştürüldüğü tahmin ediliyor.
Geri dönüşüm için toplanan plastiğin üçte birinden fazlasının yeni ürünlere dönüştürüldüğü kanıtlandı.
Yeni ürünlerin yalnızca üçte biri geri dönüştürülmüş plastikten üretiliyor.
Plastiğin yalnızca üçte biri geri dönüşüm için toplanıyor ve geri kalanı yeni ürünlere dönüştürülüyor.
Geri dönüşüm için toplanan plastiğin üçte ikisinin yeni ürünlere dönüştürüleceği tahmin ediliyor.
exercises.explanation: ‘It is estimated that’ (tahmin ediliyor), ‘only about a third’ (yalnızca üçte biri) ve ‘actually turned into new products’ (gerçekten yeni ürünlere dönüştürüldüğü) öğelerinin hepsi ‘Geri dönüşüm için toplanan plastiğin yalnızca üçte birinin gerçekten yeni ürünlere dönüştürüldüğü tahmin ediliyor.’ cümlesindedir. ‘fazlasının … kanıtlandı’ hem oranı hem kesinliği değiştirir; ‘Yeni ürünlerin yalnızca üçte biri’ özne ile nesneyi yer değiştirir; ‘toplanıyor ve geri kalanı’ anlamı bozar; ‘üçte ikisinin’ ise oranı yanlış verir.

exercises.passage: For most of history, weaving a fabric with a complicated pattern was slow and expensive work. On a traditional loom, each design required a skilled weaver and an assistant, often a child, who sat above the machine and lifted individual threads by hand according to the weaver's instructions. A single mistake could ruin hours of labour, and a richly decorated silk might advance by only a few centimetres a day. In 1804, a French weaver named Joseph-Marie Jacquard demonstrated a device that changed this process fundamentally. His loom was controlled by a chain of stiff cards in which rows of holes had been punched. Where there was a hole, a needle passed through and the corresponding thread was raised; where there was none, the thread stayed down. Each card represented one row of the pattern, so a complex design could be stored as a sequence of cards and repeated as often as necessary. The invention was not welcomed by everyone. Silk weavers in Lyon, who feared that the machine would destroy their jobs, are said to have burned some of the early looms in public. Their fears were partly justified, since the assistants who had lifted the threads were no longer needed. Yet the industry as a whole expanded, and by the 1830s tens of thousands of Jacquard looms were in use across Europe. The device also had an influence far beyond textiles. The British mathematician Charles Babbage, who was designing a mechanical calculating machine, planned to use punched cards to feed it instructions, and similar cards were later used to store data in early computers. In this sense, a tool that was built to produce beautiful cloth helped to lay the foundations for the information age.

exercises.passage: Adults who try to learn a foreign language often struggle to hear the difference between sounds that native speakers find completely obvious. Japanese speakers, for example, frequently have difficulty distinguishing "r" from "l" in English, while English speakers may fail to notice distinctions that are essential in Hindi. Surprisingly, very young babies do not share this difficulty. In a series of well-known experiments carried out in the 1980s, the Canadian psychologist Janet Werker tested infants from English-speaking families on pairs of Hindi sounds which English-speaking adults could not tell apart. Because babies cannot answer questions, they were trained to turn their heads towards a toy whenever the sound changed, and their responses were recorded. At six to eight months, almost all of the infants noticed the difference. By the age of ten to twelve months, however, most of them no longer reacted to it, whereas babies of the same age from Hindi-speaking families continued to do so. Researchers describe this change as "perceptual narrowing". During the first year of life, a child's brain appears to be tuned to the sounds that matter in the language it hears every day, while gradually ignoring those that do not. Far from being a loss, this is thought to be an efficient strategy, since it allows the child to concentrate on the distinctions that will actually be needed for understanding words. The ability is not lost completely, though. Later studies have shown that adults can relearn difficult sound contrasts with intensive training, although rarely to the level of a native speaker. Such findings help to explain why an early start can give language learners an advantage, at least as far as pronunciation is concerned.
exercises.question: Which of the following could be the best title for the passage?
options: Why Japanese Is Harder to Learn Than Hindi
Teaching Babies to Recognise Their Favourite Toys
How Babies Tune Their Ears to Their Native Language
The Life and Work of a Canadian Psychologist
Why Adults Should Never Try to Learn New Sounds
exercises.explanation: Metin bebeklerin ilk yılda bütün sesleri ayırt edebilirken giderek yalnızca duydukları dilin seslerine odaklandığını (‘perceptual narrowing’) anlatır: ‘How Babies Tune Their Ears to Their Native Language’. Japonca ile Hintçenin zorluğu (‘Japanese’) karşılaştırılmaz; oyuncak (‘Toys’) yalnızca deney aracıdır; Werker’in hayatı (‘Life’) anlatılmaz; yetişkinlerin yeni sesler öğrenmemesi gerektiği (‘Never’) ise metinle çelişir, çünkü yoğun eğitimle öğrenebildikleri söylenir.

exercises.passage:
Selin: I've been checking the weather forecast all week, and it keeps changing. Yesterday it said Saturday would be sunny; today it says there will be storms.
Mark: ----
Selin: That makes sense. I suppose I should wait until Friday before I decide about the picnic.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: I always take an umbrella with me, whatever the forecast says.
Storms are much more common in the mountains than on the coast.
The weather service has recently moved to a new building.
Forecasts for more than three or four days ahead are still quite uncertain, so they are often revised.
Saturday's picnic has already been cancelled because of the storm.
exercises.explanation: Selin ‘mantıklı’ diyerek karar için cumaya kadar beklemesi gerektiğini söyler; bu, birkaç günden uzun tahminlerin belirsiz olduğu ve sık değiştiği açıklamasına verilen bir yanıttır: ‘Forecasts for more than three or four days ahead are still quite uncertain, so they are often revised.’ Şemsiye almak (‘umbrella’) tahminin neden değiştiğini açıklamaz; dağlarla kıyı karşılaştırması (‘mountains’) ve yeni bina (‘building’) konu dışıdır; pikniğin iptal edildiği (‘cancelled’) bilgisi ise Selin’in henüz karar vermemesiyle çelişir.

exercises.passage:
Teacher: Your son is doing well in class, but he hardly ever speaks English during lessons.
Mother: ----
Teacher: I understand. Many children go through a silent period like that when they start learning a new language.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: He has been studying English at this school for three years.
His older sister speaks English fluently.
I think the textbooks are much too expensive.
He finds mathematics much more interesting than English.
He has only been in the country for two months, and he is still very shy about making mistakes.
exercises.explanation: Öğretmen yeni bir dil öğrenmeye başlayan birçok çocuğun böyle sessiz bir dönemden geçtiğini söyler; bu, çocuğun ülkeye iki ay önce geldiği ve hata yapmaktan çekindiği açıklamasına uyar: ‘He has only been in the country for two months, and he is still very shy about making mistakes.’ Üç yıldır (‘three years’) öğrenmesi yeni başlamış olmasıyla çelişir; ablasının akıcılığı (‘sister’) ve kitapların pahalılığı (‘textbooks’) sessizliği açıklamaz; matematiğe ilgisi (‘mathematics’) de öğretmenin dil öğrenimiyle ilgili yanıtına uymaz.

exercises.passage:
Ali: Did you know that the old copper pipes from our building are going to be sold to a recycling company?
Rachel: Really? ----
Ali: Quite a lot, actually. Copper prices are very high at the moment, so the money will pay for part of the new heating system.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: When will the new pipes be installed?
Who decided to replace the heating system?
Will the building get much money for them?

As soon as the salmon entered the river, they started swimming upstream towards the streams where they had been born.
The salmon hardly ever swim upstream to the streams where they were born.
