exercises.explanation: ‘No sooner had … than’ bir olayın hemen ardından ötekinin geldiğini anlatır: somonlar nehre girer girmez akıntıya karşı yüzmeye başladı (‘As soon as the salmon entered the river, they started swimming upstream …’). ‘for a long time before’ sıralamayı tersine çevirir; ‘hardly ever’ eylemin nadiren olduğunu söyler; ‘did not swim’ anlamı tersine çevirir; ‘Only a few’ ise asıl cümlede olmayan bir sayı bilgisi ekler.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The textile industry would not have grown so quickly in the nineteenth century if it had not been for cheap cotton from overseas.
options: Without cheap cotton from overseas, the textile industry could not have grown so quickly in the nineteenth century.
Although cotton from overseas was cheap, the textile industry grew very slowly in the nineteenth century.
The rapid growth of the textile industry made overseas cotton much cheaper in the nineteenth century.
In the nineteenth century, the textile industry stopped using cotton from overseas because it was too expensive.
The textile industry grew quickly in the nineteenth century, even without cheap cotton from overseas.
exercises.explanation: ‘if it had not been for’ (… olmasaydı) yapısı ucuz pamuğun hızlı büyümenin koşulu olduğunu anlatır; aynı anlamı ‘Without cheap cotton from overseas, the textile industry could not have grown so quickly …’ verir. ‘grew very slowly’ büyümenin hızlı olduğu bilgisiyle çelişir; ‘made overseas cotton much cheaper’ neden ile sonucu yer değiştirir; ‘stopped using … too expensive’ anlamı tersine çevirir; ‘even without’ ise pamuğun gerekli olmadığını söyler.

exercises.passage: Modern weather forecasts are based on computer models that divide the atmosphere into millions of boxes and calculate how temperature, pressure and wind will change in each one. Because the atmosphere is so sensitive, a tiny error in the starting measurements can grow into a large error a week later. ---- If most of these runs produce rain on a particular day, forecasters can be fairly confident; if they disagree widely, the forecast is given with a much lower level of certainty.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: The first weather satellite was launched by the United States in 1960.
Many people still check the forecast on their phones several times a day.
Some old sayings about the weather, such as those about red skies, contain a grain of truth.
To deal with this problem, forecasters run the same model dozens of times, each time with slightly different starting conditions.
Television weather presenters often receive training in meteorology.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan önce küçük ölçüm hatalarının büyüyebildiği sorunu verilir; sonraki cümle ise ‘these runs’ ifadesiyle modelin birçok kez çalıştırıldığını varsayar. Bu bağı ‘To deal with this problem, forecasters run the same model dozens of times …’ kurar. Uydu tarihi (‘satellite’), telefonda tahmine bakmak (‘phones’), halk sözleri (‘sayings’) ve sunucuların eğitimi (‘presenters’) ‘these runs’ ifadesine dayanak oluşturmaz.

exercises.passage: Young salmon leave the river where they hatched and spend several years feeding in the open ocean, sometimes thousands of kilometres away. When they are ready to breed, however, almost all of them return to the very same stream. ---- Experiments have shown, for example, that salmon whose sense of smell has been blocked are far less likely to find their home stream.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Salmon is one of the most popular kinds of fish served in restaurants.
Scientists believe that, once the fish reach the coast, they find their way largely by recognising the particular smell of their home river.
Many rivers have been blocked by dams, which make the journey upstream much harder.
Bears and eagles catch large numbers of salmon as they swim upstream.
Some salmon farms keep the fish in large cages near the coast.
exercises.explanation: Son cümle koku alma duyusu engellenen somonların yuvalarını daha zor bulduğunu ‘for example’ ile örnekler; demek ki boşlukta somonların yolu kokuyla bulduğu savı olmalıdır: ‘Scientists believe that … they find their way largely by recognising the particular smell of their home river.’ Lokantalar (‘restaurants’), barajlar (‘dams’), ayılar ve kartallar (‘eagles’) ile çiftlikler (‘farms’) bu örneğin desteklediği bir sav sunmaz.

exercises.passage: (I) European eels begin their lives in the Sargasso Sea, a calm area of the western Atlantic Ocean. (II) Eels are considered a delicacy in several countries, where they are often smoked or served in jelly. (III) As tiny, transparent larvae, they drift with ocean currents for up to three years until they reach the coasts of Europe. (IV) There they swim into rivers and lakes, where they may live for decades before changing colour and preparing to return. (V) Finally, the adult eels cross the Atlantic once more to breed in the Sargasso Sea and die, at the end of a journey of some 6,000 kilometres.
exercises.question: Paragrafta anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
options: I
II
III
IV
V
exercises.explanation: Paragraf Avrupa yılan balığının Sargasso Denizi’nden Avrupa’ya ve geri dönüşüne uzanan göç yolculuğunu sırasıyla anlatır. ‘II’ numaralı cümle de yılan balığından söz eder ama göçten ayrılıp bazı ülkelerde yemek olarak nasıl sunulduğuna geçer. ‘I’ yolculuğun başlangıcını, ‘III’ larvaların okyanusta sürüklenmesini, ‘IV’ nehirlerdeki yaşamı, ‘V’ ise geri dönüşü anlatır.

exercises.passage: (I) In 1859, a violent storm sank the ship Royal Charter off the coast of Wales, and more than 450 people lost their lives. (II) The disaster convinced Robert FitzRoy, the head of Britain's new weather office, that storms could be predicted and that sailors could be warned in time. (III) He collected weather reports sent by telegraph from stations around the coast and used them to draw maps showing how the weather was changing. (IV) Many years earlier, FitzRoy had been the captain of the Beagle, the ship on which Charles Darwin sailed around the world. (V) In 1861, these maps allowed him to issue the first public storm warnings, and The Times newspaper soon began printing his daily forecasts.
exercises.question: Paragrafta anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
options: I
II
III
IV
V
exercises.explanation: Paragraf Royal Charter felaketinin FitzRoy’u fırtınaların önceden bildirilebileceğine nasıl inandırdığını ve ilk fırtına uyarılarına nasıl ulaşıldığını anlatır. ‘IV’ numaralı cümle de FitzRoy’dan söz eder ama hava tahmininden ayrılıp onun daha önce Beagle gemisinin kaptanı olmasına geçer. ‘I’ felaketi, ‘II’ FitzRoy’un buradan çıkardığı sonucu, ‘III’ telgrafla toplanan raporları ve haritaları, ‘V’ ise bu haritalarla verilen uyarıları anlatır.

exercises.passage: (I) In many old European cities, streets were originally named after the trades practised in them or the places they led to, such as Bakers’ Lane or London Road. (II) As cities grew in the nineteenth century, local councils began to take control of naming, partly to avoid the confusion caused by dozens of streets with the same name. (III) Street signs in some cities are made of enamel, a material that resists rain and keeps its colour for decades. (IV) Today, new names are often chosen to honour famous local people or important historical events. (V) Because such choices can carry political meaning, the renaming of a street is sometimes the subject of fierce public debate.
exercises.question: Paragrafta anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
options: I
II
III
IV
V
exercises.explanation: Paragraf şehirlerde sokaklara verilen adların nasıl seçildiğini ve bu uygulamanın zamanla nasıl değiştiğini anlatır. ‘III’ numaralı cümle de sokaklarla ilgilidir ama adların seçilmesinden ayrılıp sokak tabelalarının yapıldığı malzemeye geçer. ‘I’ eski adların mesleklerden ve yönlerden geldiğini, ‘II’ belediyelerin ad vermeyi üstlenmesini, ‘IV’ bugün adların ünlü kişileri ve olayları onurlandırmak için seçilmesini, ‘V’ ise ad değiştirmenin yol açtığı tartışmaları anlatır.

exercises.passage: (I) In 1856, an eighteen-year-old chemistry student named William Perkin was trying to produce a medicine for malaria from coal tar. (II) The experiment failed, but it left behind a dark substance that, when dissolved, coloured silk a bright purple. (III) Realising its commercial value, Perkin left his studies and opened a factory to manufacture the new dye, which he called mauve. (IV) The colour quickly became fashionable, especially after Queen Victoria wore a mauve dress at a royal wedding. (V) Today, natural dyes made from plants are becoming popular again among shoppers who are worried about the chemicals used in modern clothing.
exercises.question: Paragrafta anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
options: I
II
III
IV
V
exercises.explanation: Paragraf Perkin’in ilk yapay boyayı nasıl rastlantıyla bulduğunu ve bu boyanın nasıl moda olduğunu sırasıyla anlatır. ‘V’ numaralı cümle de boyalardan söz eder ama Perkin’in buluşundan ayrılıp bugün bitkisel boyaların yeniden sevilmesine geçer. ‘I’ deneyin amacını, ‘II’ başarısız deneyden çıkan maddeyi, ‘III’ fabrikanın kurulmasını, ‘IV’ ise rengin moda olmasını anlatır.

units.title: Ara tekrar 3
units.description: Edatlar, miktar, akademik fiiller ve toplum, ekonomi, teknoloji kelimeleriyle karışık tekrar; Yarım deneme 4’e hazırlık
units.guide:
## Bu haftaya kadar neler gördün?
Bu ünite ilk iki ara tekrarın üzerine edatları (*by / until, since / for, result in / from*), miktar ve karşılaştırma yapılarını (*few / a few, neither, the more … the less, so / such*), akademik fiilleri (*refute, attribute, enhance*) ve toplum, ekonomi, teknoloji kelimelerini ekler. Karşına çıkan soru tipleri: kelime, dilbilgisi, cloze, cümle tamamlama, çeviri (İng→Tr ve Tr→İng), okuma, diyalog, yakın anlam, paragraf tamamlama ve anlamı bozan cümle.

## Yarım deneme 4 için zaman planı (90 dk)
- **Kelime ve dilbilgisi: 20 dk.** Bilmediğin kelimede takılma, işaretle ve geç.
- **Cloze ve cümle tamamlama: 25 dk.** Önce bağlacı ve zaman uyumunu kontrol et.
- **Okuma: 30 dk.** Önce soruyu oku, sonra kanıtı metinde bul.
- **Çeviri, diyalog, paragraf: 15 dk.** Son 5 dakikayı boş bıraktığın sorulara ayır.

## Denemeden sonra
1. Her yanlışın nedenini **Hata defteri**ne yaz: kelimeyi bilmedim, yapıyı karıştırdım, metni yanlış okudum, zaman yetmedi.
2. En çok yanlış yaptığın soru tipini seç ve o tipin dersini ertesi gün yeniden çöz.
3. Doğru yaptığın ama emin olmadığın soruların açıklamalarını da oku; şans eseri doğrular sınavda tekrar etmez.

nodes.title: Dilbilgisi ve cloze
nodes.description: Yaz saati uygulaması üzerine bir cloze metni; zaman, edat, miktar ve karşılaştırma yapıları

exercises.passage: The idea of moving clocks forward in spring is often (1)---- to Benjamin Franklin, but his famous letter of 1784 was largely a joke about lazy Parisians who slept (2)---- noon. The first country to adopt the practice seriously was Germany, which introduced it in 1916 in order to save coal during the First World War. Britain followed (3)---- a few weeks, and many other governments soon did the same. Supporters argued that an extra hour of evening daylight would reduce the amount of fuel needed for lighting. (4)----, modern studies have produced mixed results: in some regions, the savings on lighting are cancelled out by greater use of air conditioning on warm evenings. Medical researchers have also raised concerns, since the sudden change in March appears to disturb sleep for several days. As a result, a number of countries have abandoned the practice altogether, and (5)---- the European Parliament voted in 2019 to end it, member states have still not agreed on which time to keep.
exercises.question: (1) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
options: referred
contributed
attributed
complied
relied
exercises.explanation: Bir fikri birine mal etmek ‘attribute X to Y’ kalıbıyla anlatılır; edilgen hâli ‘is attributed to Benjamin Franklin’ (Franklin’e atfedilir) olur. ‘referred to’ ‘söz edilmek’ anlamına gelir ve fikri birine mal etmez; ‘contributed to’ (katkıda bulunmak) ve ‘complied with’ (uymak) anlam vermez; ‘relied on’ ise ‘to’ ile kullanılmaz.

exercises.passage: The idea of moving clocks forward in spring is often (1)---- to Benjamin Franklin, but his famous letter of 1784 was largely a joke about lazy Parisians who slept (2)---- noon. The first country to adopt the practice seriously was Germany, which introduced it in 1916 in order to save coal during the First World War. Britain followed (3)---- a few weeks, and many other governments soon did the same. Supporters argued that an extra hour of evening daylight would reduce the amount of fuel needed for lighting. (4)----, modern studies have produced mixed results: in some regions, the savings on lighting are cancelled out by greater use of air conditioning on warm evenings. Medical researchers have also raised concerns, since the sudden change in March appears to disturb sleep for several days. As a result, a number of countries have abandoned the practice altogether, and (5)---- the European Parliament voted in 2019 to end it, member states have still not agreed on which time to keep.
exercises.question: (2) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
options: by
since
during
among
until
exercises.explanation: Uyumak süregelen bir eylemdir ve bitiş noktası ‘öğlene kadar’ anlamında ‘until noon’ ile verilir. ‘by noon’ ‘en geç öğlene’ demektir ve süreklilik bildirmez; ‘since’ başlangıç noktası ister ve geçmiş zamanlı bu cümleye uymaz; ‘during’ bir süre ismi (during the night) ister; ‘among’ ise yer/grup edatıdır.

exercises.passage: The idea of moving clocks forward in spring is often (1)---- to Benjamin Franklin, but his famous letter of 1784 was largely a joke about lazy Parisians who slept (2)---- noon. The first country to adopt the practice seriously was Germany, which introduced it in 1916 in order to save coal during the First World War. Britain followed (3)---- a few weeks, and many other governments soon did the same. Supporters argued that an extra hour of evening daylight would reduce the amount of fuel needed for lighting. (4)----, modern studies have produced mixed results: in some regions, the savings on lighting are cancelled out by greater use of air conditioning on warm evenings. Medical researchers have also raised concerns, since the sudden change in March appears to disturb sleep for several days. As a result, a number of countries have abandoned the practice altogether, and (5)---- the European Parliament voted in 2019 to end it, member states have still not agreed on which time to keep.
exercises.question: (3) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
options: within
since
until
among
along
exercises.explanation: İngiltere’nin Almanya’yı ‘birkaç hafta içinde’ izlediği anlatılır: ‘within a few weeks’. ‘since a few weeks’ dilbilgisel değildir (since bir başlangıç noktası ister); ‘until a few weeks’ bitiş noktası bildirir ve anlamsızdır; ‘among’ ve ‘along’ ise yer edatlarıdır ve süre bildirmez.

exercises.passage: The idea of moving clocks forward in spring is often (1)---- to Benjamin Franklin, but his famous letter of 1784 was largely a joke about lazy Parisians who slept (2)---- noon. The first country to adopt the practice seriously was Germany, which introduced it in 1916 in order to save coal during the First World War. Britain followed (3)---- a few weeks, and many other governments soon did the same. Supporters argued that an extra hour of evening daylight would reduce the amount of fuel needed for lighting. (4)----, modern studies have produced mixed results: in some regions, the savings on lighting are cancelled out by greater use of air conditioning on warm evenings. Medical researchers have also raised concerns, since the sudden change in March appears to disturb sleep for several days. As a result, a number of countries have abandoned the practice altogether, and (5)---- the European Parliament voted in 2019 to end it, member states have still not agreed on which time to keep.
exercises.question: (4) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
options: Therefore
Similarly
For instance
However
In addition
exercises.explanation: Önceki cümlede savunucuların yakıt tasarrufu beklentisi, sonrakinde ise çalışmaların ‘karışık sonuçlar’ verdiği anlatılır; bu karşıtlığı ‘However’ kurar. ‘Therefore’ sonuç bildirir; ‘Similarly’ benzerlik, ‘In addition’ ekleme bildirir; ‘For instance’ ise bir örnek sunar, oysa sonraki cümle örnek değil karşı görüştür.

exercises.passage: The idea of moving clocks forward in spring is often (1)---- to Benjamin Franklin, but his famous letter of 1784 was largely a joke about lazy Parisians who slept (2)---- noon. The first country to adopt the practice seriously was Germany, which introduced it in 1916 in order to save coal during the First World War. Britain followed (3)---- a few weeks, and many other governments soon did the same. Supporters argued that an extra hour of evening daylight would reduce the amount of fuel needed for lighting. (4)----, modern studies have produced mixed results: in some regions, the savings on lighting are cancelled out by greater use of air conditioning on warm evenings. Medical researchers have also raised concerns, since the sudden change in March appears to disturb sleep for several days. As a result, a number of countries have abandoned the practice altogether, and (5)---- the European Parliament voted in 2019 to end it, member states have still not agreed on which time to keep.
exercises.question: (5) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
options: because
although
unless
so that
as long as
exercises.explanation: Parlamentonun uygulamayı kaldırmak için oy vermesi ile üye ülkelerin hâlâ anlaşamaması arasında zıtlık vardır: ‘although’ (-e rağmen). ‘because’ neden bildirir ve mantığı bozar; ‘unless’ ve ‘as long as’ koşul bildirir, geçmişte olmuş bir oylamaya uymaz; ‘so that’ ise amaç bildirir.

exercises.question: By the time the new timetable comes into force next March, the railway company ---- most of its old diesel trains.
options: has replaced
had replaced
will have replaced
replaces
would replace
exercises.explanation: ‘By the time’ + geniş zaman gelecekteki bir ana kadar tamamlanmış olacak bir eylemi gösterir; bu yüzden ‘will have replaced’ (değiştirmiş olacak) gerekir. ‘has replaced’ şimdiye kadar olanı, ‘had replaced’ geçmişteki bir andan önceyi anlatır; ‘replaces’ tamamlanmışlık bildirmez; ‘would replace’ ise koşul ya da geçmişte gelecek anlamı taşır ve ‘comes’ ile uyuşmaz.

exercises.question: Very ---- people realise that the length of a solar day is not exactly the same throughout the year.
options: little
a little
much
few
less
exercises.explanation: ‘people’ sayılabilen çoğul bir isimdir ve olumsuz anlamda ‘pek az’ demek için ‘Very few people’ kullanılır. ‘little’, ‘a little’ ve ‘much’ sayılamayan isimlerle kullanılır; ‘less’ ise karşılaştırma bildirir ve ‘Very’ ile birlikte bir isim önünde bu anlamı vermez.

exercises.question: Neither of the two clocks in the station hall ---- the correct time, so passengers often rely on their phones instead.
options: show
are showing
have shown
were shown
shows
exercises.explanation: ‘Neither of’ + çoğul isim sınav dilbilgisinde tekil fiil alır ve genel bir durum anlatıldığı için geniş zaman gerekir: ‘shows’. ‘show’, ‘are showing’ ve ‘have shown’ çoğul fiildir; ‘were shown’ ise edilgendir ve ‘saatler doğru zamanı gösterdi’ anlamını veremez.

exercises.question: The calendar ---- by Pope Gregory XIII in 1582 was adopted by Britain and its colonies only in 1752.
options: introduced
was introduced
introducing
which introduced
has introduced
exercises.explanation: Cümlenin ana fiili ‘was adopted’ dır; boşluğa ‘The calendar’ ı niteleyen kısaltılmış edilgen sıfat-fiil gelir: ‘introduced’ (getirilen). ‘was introduced’ ve ‘has introduced’ ikinci bir çekimli fiil yaratır; ‘introducing’ etken anlam taşır (takvim bir şey getirmez); ‘which introduced’ da etken çatıdadır ve anlamı bozar.

exercises.question: The longer candidates spend on a single difficult question, ---- time they have left for the reading section.
options: the fewer
the less
less than
the least
so little
exercises.explanation: ‘The longer …, the less …’ (ne kadar … o kadar az) yapısı iki karşılaştırmayı birbirine bağlar; ‘time’ sayılamayan bir isim olduğu için ‘the less’ gerekir. ‘the fewer’ sayılabilen isimlerle kullanılır; ‘less than’ yapıyı tamamlamaz; ‘the least’ en üstünlük bildirir; ‘so little’ ise ‘the longer’ ile kurulan paralel yapıya uymaz.

exercises.question: If the city council had approved the budget in January, the restoration of the old clock tower ---- before the summer festival.
options: would be completed
will be completed
had been completed
would have been completed
was completed
exercises.explanation: ‘If … had approved’ geçmişe ait gerçek dışı (üçüncü tip) bir koşuldur ve ana cümlede ‘would have been completed’ ister; kule restore edildiği için edilgen gerekir. ‘would be completed’ ikinci tip koşula aittir; ‘will be completed’ gerçek bir gelecek bildirir; ‘had been completed’ ve ‘was completed’ ise koşulun sonucunu değil olmuş bir olguyu anlatır.

exercises.question: It was ---- short meeting that nobody had time to discuss the new working hours.
options: so
too
enough
very
such a
exercises.explanation: Sıfat + tekil isim (‘short meeting’) önünde ‘öyle … ki’ anlamı ‘such a … that’ ile kurulur. ‘so’ isimsiz bir sıfat ister (so short that); ‘too’ ve ‘enough’ ‘that’ ile değil ‘to’ ile kullanılır; ‘very’ ise ‘that’ ile sonuç cümlesi kuramaz.

nodes.title: Cümle tamamlama ve çeviri
nodes.description: Bağlaç ve zaman uyumuyla cümle tamamlama; İngilizce-Türkçe ve Türkçe-İngilizce çeviri

exercises.question: Since the factory began to automate its night shifts, ----.
options: it has needed far fewer workers between midnight and dawn
the workers had been paid twice as much as before
unless the machines are switched off at weekends
which most of the managers considered unnecessary
it will have hired more staff by the previous year
exercises.explanation: ‘Since’ burada ‘-den beri’ anlamındadır ve ana cümlede şimdiki mükemmel zaman ister: ‘it has needed far fewer workers between midnight and dawn’. ‘had been paid’ zaman uyumunu bozar; ‘unless’ ile başlayan seçenek ana cümle değildir; ‘which … managers’ bir yan cümledir; ‘will have hired … previous year’ ise gelecek zaman ile geçmiş zaman ifadesini çelişkili biçimde birleştirir.

exercises.question: Although the referendum on Sunday shop opening hours attracted a high turnout, ----.
options: most shops have therefore opened on Sundays ever since
the municipal council postponed its decision until the following spring
because the results were announced late at night
the turnout was even higher than in the previous election
so many voters had stayed at home on the day of the vote
exercises.explanation: ‘Although’ beklenmedik bir sonuç ister: yüksek katılıma rağmen belediye meclisi kararını ertelemiştir: ‘the municipal council postponed its decision until the following spring’. ‘therefore’ sonuç bildirir ve zıtlıkla çelişir; ‘because’ ile başlayan seçenek ana cümle değildir; ‘even higher’ zıtlık değil destek bildirir; ‘stayed at home’ ise yüksek katılımla doğrudan çelişir.

exercises.question: ----, the bank had to borrow money overnight in order to pay its creditors.
options: Even though its reserves were far larger than the law required
Unless its debtors repay their loans before the deadline
Because it did not have enough liquidity at the end of the day
So that its fiscal year could end in December
As soon as it will open new branches overseas
exercises.explanation: Bankanın gece borç almak zorunda kalmasının nedeni gün sonunda yeterli nakdinin olmamasıdır: ‘Because it did not have enough liquidity at the end of the day’. ‘reserves were far larger’ borç alma ihtiyacıyla çelişir; ‘Unless … repay’ gerçek koşuldur ve ‘had to’ ile zaman uyumu kurmaz; ‘fiscal year’ ile kurulan amaç anlamsızdır; ‘As soon as it will open’ ise dilbilgisel değildir (zaman bağlacından sonra will gelmez).

exercises.question: The researchers did not acknowledge the limitations of their sleep study until ----.
options: they will publish a second paper next year
which was funded by a private technology company
since they have been working on the project for years
other scientists pointed out that the sample consisted of only twelve students
the results are presented at the conference in May
exercises.explanation: ‘did not … until’ geçmişte bir olaya kadar süren bir durumu anlatır ve geçmiş zamanlı bir olay ister: ‘other scientists pointed out that the sample consisted of only twelve students’. ‘will publish’ ve ‘are presented’ zaman uyumunu bozar; ‘which … funded’ bir yan cümle olup ‘until’ den sonra gelemez; ‘since they have been working’ ise iki bağlacı yan yana getirir.

exercises.question: Children who are given too little time to finish their homework ----.
options: whose teachers rarely set strict deadlines
if they had finished it before dinner
so that they could play outside with their friends
even though spending more hours at school
tend to make more careless mistakes than those who can work at their own pace
exercises.explanation: Cümlenin öznesi ‘Children who are given too little time …’ dır ve bir ana fiil eksiktir: ‘tend to make more careless mistakes than those who can work at their own pace’. ‘whose teachers’ ikinci bir yan cümledir ve yüklem vermez; ‘if they had finished’ ve ‘so that they could play’ yan cümledir; ‘even though spending’ ise dilbilgisel değildir.

exercises.question: No sooner had the engineers restarted the server ----.
options: than the website began to load twice as fast
when they had already gone home for the night
until the bandwidth is increased next month
because the algorithm had been altered
so the users will have been notified by email
exercises.explanation: ‘No sooner had … than’ kalıbı ‘… yapar yapmaz’ anlamı verir ve ‘than’ ile tamamlanır: ‘than the website began to load twice as fast’. ‘when’ bu kalıpta ‘than’ yerine kullanılmaz ve anlamı da çelişkilidir; ‘until … is increased’ zaman uyumunu bozar; ‘because the algorithm’ ve ‘so the users will’ ise kalıbı tamamlamaz.

exercises.question:
Aşağıdaki İngilizce cümlenin anlamca en yakın Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?

Few historians would deny that the introduction of standard time greatly enhanced the efficiency of railway networks.
options: Birçok tarihçi standart saatin demiryolu ağlarının verimliliğini azalttığını ileri sürer.
Standart saatin getirilmesinin demiryolu ağlarının verimliliğini büyük ölçüde artırdığını pek az tarihçi inkâr eder.
Standart saatin demiryolu ağlarında kullanılması, tarihçiler tarafından büyük ölçüde eleştirilmiştir.
Pek az tarihçi, demiryolu ağlarının standart saatin getirilmesine yol açtığını kabul eder.
Standart saat getirilmeseydi, tarihçilere göre demiryolu ağları daha verimli olurdu.
exercises.explanation: ‘Few historians would deny’ (pek az tarihçi inkâr eder), ‘introduction of standard time’ (standart saatin getirilmesi) ve ‘greatly enhanced the efficiency’ (verimliliği büyük ölçüde artırdı) öğelerinin hepsi ‘…verimliliğini büyük ölçüde artırdığını pek az tarihçi inkâr eder.’ cümlesinde vardır. ‘Birçok tarihçi … azalttığını’ anlamı tersine çevirir; ‘eleştirilmiştir’ cümlede olmayan bir eleştiri ekler; ‘yol açtığını kabul eder’ neden-sonuç ilişkisini tersine çevirir; ‘getirilmeseydi’ ise gerçek dışı bir koşul kurar.

exercises.question:
Aşağıdaki İngilizce cümlenin anlamca en yakın Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?

The study revealed that employees who were allowed to choose their own working hours were no less productive than those on fixed schedules.
options: Çalışma, kendi çalışma saatlerini seçen çalışanların sabit programla çalışanlardan daha az üretken olduğunu ortaya koydu.
Çalışma, sabit programla çalışanların kendi saatlerini seçmek istediğini gösterdi.
Çalışma, kendi çalışma saatlerini seçmelerine izin verilen çalışanların sabit programla çalışanlardan daha az üretken olmadığını ortaya koydu.
Araştırmacılar, çalışanlara saatlerini seçme izni verilirse üretkenliğin artacağını ileri sürdü.
Çalışanların çoğu, kendi saatlerini seçmenin üretkenliklerini etkilemediğine inanıyor.
exercises.explanation: ‘revealed’ (ortaya koydu), ‘who were allowed to choose’ (seçmelerine izin verilen) ve ‘no less productive than’ (… -den daha az üretken değil) öğeleri ‘…daha az üretken olmadığını ortaya koydu.’ cümlesinde vardır. ‘daha az üretken olduğunu’ olumsuzluğu kaldırıp anlamı tersine çevirir; ‘seçmek istediğini’ başka bir bulgu anlatır; ‘artacağını ileri sürdü’ bulguyu bir tahmine çevirir; ‘inanıyor’ ise çalışmanın sonucunu çalışanların görüşüne dönüştürür.

exercises.question:
Aşağıdaki İngilizce cümlenin anlamca en yakın Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?

Had the warning been transmitted a few minutes earlier, most of the villages could have been evacuated in time.
options: Uyarı birkaç dakika erken iletildiği için köylerin çoğu zamanında boşaltıldı.
Uyarı birkaç dakika daha erken iletilirse köylerin hepsi zamanında boşaltılacak.
Köylerin çoğu, uyarı iletilmeden birkaç dakika önce boşaltılmıştı.
Uyarı birkaç dakika daha erken iletilmiş olsaydı, köylerin çoğu zamanında boşaltılabilirdi.
Uyarının erken iletilmesine rağmen köylerin pek azı zamanında boşaltılabildi.
exercises.explanation: ‘Had the warning been transmitted’ devrik yapısı ‘If the warning had been transmitted’ demektir ve geçmişe ait gerçek dışı bir koşuldur; ‘could have been evacuated’ (boşaltılabilirdi) ile birlikte doğru karşılık ‘Uyarı birkaç dakika daha erken iletilmiş olsaydı, köylerin çoğu zamanında boşaltılabilirdi.’ dir. ‘iletildiği için … boşaltıldı’ olmamış bir olayı olmuş gibi anlatır; ‘iletilirse … hepsi … boşaltılacak’ gelecek ve ‘hepsi’ ekler; ‘önce boşaltılmıştı’ sırayı değiştirir; ‘rağmen … pek azı’ ise anlamı tersine çevirir.

exercises.question:
Aşağıdaki Türkçe cümlenin anlamca en yakın İngilizce karşılığı hangisidir?

Belediye, yeni otobüs saatlerinin yolcuların çoğunun ihtiyaçlarını karşılayıp karşılamadığını değerlendirmek için bir anket başlattı.
options: The municipality launched a survey because most passengers had complained about the new bus timetable.
The new bus timetable was assessed by passengers before the municipality decided to change it.
The municipality refused to assess the new bus timetable despite the needs of most passengers.
Most passengers started a survey to prove that the new bus timetable met their needs.
The municipality launched a survey to assess whether the new bus timetable meets the needs of most passengers.
exercises.explanation: ‘değerlendirmek için’ amaç bildirir (to assess), ‘karşılayıp karşılamadığını’ ise ‘whether … meets’ ile verilir; bu öğelerin hepsi ‘The municipality launched a survey to assess whether the new bus timetable meets the needs of most passengers.’ cümlesindedir. ‘complained’ Türkçede olmayan bir şikâyet ekler; ‘decided to change’ değişiklik kararı uydurur; ‘refused’ anlamı tersine çevirir; ‘prove’ ise anketi başlatanı ve amacı değiştirir.

exercises.question:
Aşağıdaki Türkçe cümlenin anlamca en yakın İngilizce karşılığı hangisidir?

Toplantı, katılımcıların hiçbiri zamanında gelmediği için bir saat ertelendi.
options: The meeting was postponed for an hour because none of the participants arrived on time.
The meeting lasted an hour although all of the participants arrived late.
Since few participants arrived on time, the meeting was cancelled.
The meeting would have been postponed if none of the participants had arrived on time.
None of the participants knew that the meeting had been brought forward by an hour.
exercises.explanation: ‘hiçbiri … gelmediği için’ ‘because none of the participants arrived on time’, ‘bir saat ertelendi’ ise ‘was postponed for an hour’ demektir; doğru karşılık ‘The meeting was postponed for an hour because none of the participants arrived on time.’ dır. ‘lasted … although’ ertelemeyi süreye çevirir; ‘few’ ve ‘cancelled’ hem miktarı hem sonucu değiştirir; ‘would have been postponed’ olmuş bir olayı gerçek dışı koşula çevirir; ‘brought forward’ ise toplantının öne alındığını söyler.

exercises.passage: Since 1967, the official length of a second has been defined not by the movement of the Earth but by the vibrations of caesium atoms, which atomic clocks can count with extraordinary precision. The Earth, however, is a far less reliable timekeeper. Its rotation is gradually slowing down because of the pull of the Moon on the oceans, and it also speeds up or slows down slightly from year to year as a result of changes in the planet's molten core, melting ice and even large earthquakes. To keep atomic time in step with the position of the Sun, scientists introduced the leap second in 1972: whenever the gap between the two approaches nine-tenths of a second, an extra second is added to the last minute of June or December. Twenty-seven leap seconds have been inserted so far. For astronomers, the system works well enough, but for the operators of computer networks it has become a serious headache. Because a leap second is announced only about six months in advance and occurs irregularly, software must handle a minute that lasts sixty-one seconds, something many programs were never designed to do. In 2012, the extra second caused several popular websites and an airline's booking system to crash for hours. Partly for this reason, the international body responsible for measuring time voted in 2022 to stop adding leap seconds by 2035. Critics acknowledge the technical problems but warn that, over centuries, clocks and the Sun will gradually drift apart unless a different correction is eventually agreed.
exercises.question: The passage is mainly concerned with ----.
options: how atomic clocks count the vibrations of caesium atoms
why the leap second was introduced and why it is going to be abandoned
the reasons why the Earth rotates more slowly every year
a famous computer failure that affected an airline in 2012
the work of astronomers who measure the position of the Sun
exercises.explanation: Parça artık saniyenin neden getirildiğini (atom saati ile Dünya’nın dönüşünü uyumlu tutmak), bilgisayar ağlarına yarattığı sorunları ve 2035’e kadar kaldırılma kararını anlatır: ‘why the leap second was introduced and why it is going to be abandoned’. Sezyum atomları (‘caesium’) yalnızca girişte geçen bir ayrıntıdır; Dünya’nın yavaşlaması (‘rotates’) ve 2012 arızası (‘airline’) ana fikri destekleyen ayrıntılardır; gökbilimcilerin çalışması (‘astronomers’) ise konunun kendisi değildir.

astronomers find that atomic clocks have stopped working properly

computer networks need extra time to process bookings at the end of the year
the Moon is at its closest point to the oceans in June or December

options: are able to predict leap seconds several years before they occur
were designed by astronomers who wanted to measure the Earth's rotation

exercises.explanation: Yazılımların altmış bir saniyelik bir dakikayla başa çıkmak zorunda kaldığı ve birçok programın buna göre ‘hiç tasarlanmadığı’ söylenir; buradan programların her dakikanın tam altmış saniye olduğunu varsaydığı çıkarılır: ‘were written on the assumption that every minute contains exactly sixty seconds’. exercises.question: The critics mentioned at the end of the passage ----.
options: accept that leap seconds cause difficulties but are worried about the long-term effects of abolishing them
deny that leap seconds have ever caused serious technical problems

want leap seconds to be added every month instead of twice a year

exercises.passage: In a time bank, the only currency is the hour. Members offer services to one another, such as repairing a bicycle, teaching a language or looking after a neighbour's garden, and every hour of work earns one time credit, which can later be spent on an hour of someone else's help. Crucially, all hours are treated as equal: an hour of legal advice is worth exactly the same as an hour of dog walking. The idea was popularised in the United States in the 1980s by the lawyer Edgar Cahn, who argued that the market economy undervalues the work that holds communities together, such as caring for the elderly. Today, thousands of time banks operate around the world, from small villages in Japan to large cities in Britain. Supporters claim that they strengthen social ties and give people who are unemployed or retired a sense of being useful. Some studies indicate that members report lower levels of loneliness, although it is difficult to say whether time banking causes this effect or simply attracts people who are already sociable. Time banks also face practical problems. Many of them depend on a paid coordinator to match members with one another, and when public funding is cut, the bank often collapses. In addition, members tend to give far more hours than they spend, because many feel uncomfortable asking for help. Paradoxically, a time bank in which credits are earned but never spent is like a market in which goods are made but never bought. Some coordinators therefore encourage new members to request a service before they offer one.
exercises.question: The passage is mainly about ----.
options: the life and legal career of Edgar Cahn in the United States
the reasons why legal advice is more expensive than dog walking
how time banks work, what benefits they are thought to bring and what difficulties they face
a comparison between time banks in Japan and those in Britain
the role of public funding in the growth of small villages
exercises.explanation: Parça önce zaman bankasının işleyişini, sonra savunucuların ileri sürdüğü yararları, en sonda da pratik sorunları anlatır: ‘how time banks work, what benefits they are thought to bring and what difficulties they face’. Edgar Cahn (‘career’) yalnızca fikrin kaynağı olarak anılır; hukuki danışmanlığın pahalılığı (‘expensive’) parçanın tersine bir iddiadır, çünkü tüm saatler eşit sayılır; Japonya ve İngiltere karşılaştırması (‘comparison’) yapılmaz; kamu fonu ise köylerin büyümesiyle (‘growth’) değil bankaların ayakta kalmasıyla ilgili anılır.

options: members pay a small fee for every hour of help they receive
professional services such as legal advice earn more credits than simple tasks
credits can only be spent on caring for elderly members
one hour of any service earns the same credit, whatever skill it requires
coordinators decide how many hours each member must work every month

exercises.question: Some coordinators encourage new members to request a service before offering one in order to ----.

nodes.title: Diyalog, restatement, paragraf
nodes.description: Diyalog tamamlama, yakın anlamlı cümle, paragraf tamamlama ve anlamı bozan cümle

exercises.passage:
Emma: Our company is going to outsource night-time server support to a team in Manila.
Burak: ----
Emma: Exactly. When it's midnight here, their working day is just beginning, so nobody will have to stay up any more.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Will they need to learn Turkish before they start?
How much will the new servers cost us this year?
So the time difference will actually work in our favour, won't it?
Manila is famous for its beautiful sunsets over the bay.
I thought our engineers enjoyed working at night.
exercises.explanation: Emma ‘Exactly’ diyerek saat farkı sayesinde kimsenin gece uyanık kalmayacağını açıklar; bu, saat farkının işlerine yarayacağını soran ‘So the time difference will actually work in our favour, won't it?’ sorusuna verilen bir onaydır. Türkçe öğrenme (‘Turkish’) ve sunucu maliyeti (‘cost’) sorularına ‘Exactly’ ile yanıt verilmez; gün batımı (‘sunsets’) konuyla ilgisizdir; mühendislerin gece çalışmayı sevdiği (‘enjoyed’) yorumu ise Emma’nın ‘nobody will have to stay up’ yanıtıyla çelişir.

exercises.passage:
Clerk: I'm afraid the passport office closes at four, so you won't be able to hand in your form today.
Deniz: ----
Clerk: Yes, it is, but only if you bring all the documents before ten.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Why does the office close so early on weekdays?
Could you tell me where the nearest bank is?
I've already handed in the same form online twice.
Is it possible to come back tomorrow morning and still get the passport by Friday?
How long have you been working in this office?
exercises.explanation: Memurun ‘Yes, it is, but only if …’ yanıtı ‘Is it possible …?’ biçiminde bir soruya uyar ve belgeleri ertesi sabah ona kadar getirme koşulu ‘tomorrow morning’ ile örtüşür: ‘Is it possible to come back tomorrow morning and still get the passport by Friday?’ Erken kapanmanın nedeni (‘Why does’) ve çalışma süresi (‘How long’) sorularına ‘Yes, it is’ denmez; banka sorusu (‘nearest bank’) konuyla ilgisizdir; formu çevrim içi teslim ettiğini (‘online’) söylemek de bir soru değildir.

Mert: I know it'll be hard at first, but I've always been more focused early in the day.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Which book are you going to use for grammar?
I passed the exam last year with a very high score.
The exam centre is quite far from your office.
Do you prefer studying in the library or at home?
Isn't that a bit ambitious, given how late you usually go to bed?
exercises.explanation: Mert ‘I know it'll be hard at first’ diyerek bir kaygıyı kabul eder ve sabahları daha odaklı olduğunu söyleyerek kendini savunur; bu, planının zorluğunu sorgulayan ‘Isn't that a bit ambitious, given how late you usually go to bed?’ sorusuna verilen yanıttır. Kitap (‘grammar’) ve çalışma yeri (‘library’) sorularına bu yanıt uymaz; Lale’nin kendi sınav başarısı (‘passed’) ve sınav merkezinin uzaklığı (‘centre’) da Mert’in sabah planıyla ilgili bir kaygı oluşturmaz.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The new tram line was opened far later than the city had promised.
options: The city had promised to open the new tram line much earlier than it actually did.
The new tram line was opened slightly earlier than the city had planned.
The city opened the new tram line as soon as it had promised.
The city has not yet decided when to open the new tram line.
Although the tram line opened on time, the city was criticised for its cost.
exercises.explanation: ‘far later than the city had promised’ hattın söz verilenden çok daha geç açıldığını anlatır; aynı anlamı ‘The city had promised to open the new tram line much earlier than it actually did.’ verir. ‘slightly earlier’ yönü tersine çevirir; ‘as soon as it had promised’ gecikmeyi ortadan kaldırır; ‘not yet decided’ hattın açılmadığını söyler; ‘on time … cost’ ise zamanında açılış ve maliyet eleştirisi ekler.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Hardly had the referendum results been announced when protesters gathered outside the town hall.
options: Protesters gathered outside the town hall long before the referendum results were announced.
Protesters gathered outside the town hall immediately after the referendum results were announced.
The referendum results were announced only after the protesters had left the town hall.
Few protesters gathered outside the town hall, although the referendum results were surprising.
The protesters demanded that the referendum results be announced at the town hall.
exercises.explanation: ‘Hardly had … when’ ‘… olur olmaz’ anlamı verir: sonuçlar açıklanır açıklanmaz protestocular toplanmıştır; aynı anlamı ‘Protesters gathered outside the town hall immediately after the referendum results were announced.’ verir. ‘long before’ sıralamayı tersine çevirir; ‘had left’ protestocuların ayrıldığını söyler; ‘Few … surprising’ miktar ve şaşkınlık ekler; ‘demanded’ ise protestocuların bir talebini uydurur.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

It is not so much the length of the working day as the lack of breaks that exhausts nurses.
options: Nurses are exhausted by long working days rather than by a lack of breaks.
Both the length of the working day and the lack of breaks exhaust nurses to exactly the same degree.
Nurses are exhausted less by the length of their working day than by the lack of breaks.
Nurses would prefer longer working days if they were given more breaks.
Neither long working days nor the lack of breaks has any effect on nurses.
exercises.explanation: ‘not so much A as B’ ‘A’dan çok B’ demektir: hemşireleri asıl yoran mola eksikliğidir. Aynı anlamı ‘Nurses are exhausted less by the length of their working day than by the lack of breaks.’ verir. ‘rather than by a lack of breaks’ vurguyu tersine çevirir; ‘exactly the same degree’ iki etkeni eşitler; ‘would prefer’ cümlede olmayan bir tercih ekler; ‘Neither … any effect’ ise her iki etkiyi de yok sayar.

exercises.passage: In ancient Athens, speeches in the law courts were timed with a simple device called a clepsydra, or water clock. ---- When the last drop had flowed out, the speaker had to stop, even in the middle of a sentence. If a witness was called during a speech, an official blocked the hole so that the speaker did not lose any of his time.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Athenian juries were usually made up of several hundred ordinary citizens.
Modern courts no longer limit the length of speeches in this way.
Many speeches from this period were later published and studied by students of rhetoric.
It consisted of a pot with a small hole near the bottom, through which a fixed amount of water slowly drained into a second container.
Sundials were far more common in public squares than in courtrooms.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonraki ‘When the last drop had flowed out’ ve ‘blocked the hole’ ifadeleri, daha önce anılmış bir su miktarını ve bir deliği gösterir; bunları tanıtan cümle ‘It consisted of a pot with a small hole near the bottom, through which a fixed amount of water slowly drained into a second container.’ dır. Jürilerin büyüklüğü (‘juries’), bugünkü mahkemeler (‘Modern’), yayımlanan konuşmalar (‘rhetoric’) ve güneş saatleri (‘Sundials’) ‘the last drop’ ve ‘the hole’ ifadelerine bağlanmaz.

exercises.passage: In 1939, the organisers of the New York World's Fair buried a metal tube containing newspapers, seeds, a dictionary and a film of daily life, with instructions that it should be opened in the year 6939. ---- Since then, the term has been applied to thousands of similar collections sealed by schools, companies and towns. Unfortunately, many of these are never recovered, because the people who buried them die or move away without recording the exact location.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: The fair attracted more than forty million visitors over two seasons.
Metal tubes are easily damaged by water if they are not sealed properly.
Some historians doubt that anyone will be able to read today's languages in 5,000 years.
New York hosted another world's fair in the 1960s.
The organisers called their tube a 'time capsule', a name that quickly caught on.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonraki ‘Since then, the term has been applied …’ cümlesindeki ‘the term’, daha önce anılmış bir adı gösterir; bu adı tanıtan cümle ‘The organisers called their tube a 'time capsule', a name that quickly caught on.’ dır. Ziyaretçi sayısı (‘visitors’), suyun verdiği zarar (‘damaged’), dillerin okunabilirliği (‘historians’) ve ikinci fuar (‘1960s’) ‘the term’ ifadesine bağlanmaz.

exercises.passage: (I) Scientists use the term 'chronotype' to describe whether a person naturally prefers to be active early or late in the day. (II) During adolescence, most people's chronotype shifts later, so teenagers find it genuinely difficult to fall asleep before midnight. (III) Many teenagers also spend several hours a day on their phones, which have become their main source of news. (IV) For this reason, several school districts have delayed the start of morning lessons by an hour or more. (V) Early results indicate that students in these districts sleep longer and are absent less often.
exercises.question: Paragrafta anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
options: I
II
III
IV
V
exercises.explanation: Paragraf ergenlikte biyolojik saatin (kronotip) kaymasını ve okulların derslerin başlangıcını ertelemesini anlatır. ‘III’ numaralı cümle de gençlerle ilgilidir ama uyku ve kronotiptan ayrılıp telefonun haber kaynağı olmasına geçer. ‘I’ terimi tanımlar, ‘II’ ergenlikteki kaymayı anlatır, ‘IV’ ‘For this reason’ ile buna verilen okul yanıtını verir; ‘V’ ise bu uygulamanın ilk sonuçlarını aktarır.

exercises.passage: (I) In modern financial markets, a large share of trades is carried out by algorithms that buy and sell shares in a fraction of a second. (II) For the firms that use them, a delay of even a millionth of a second can mean losing a profitable deal to a faster competitor. (III) In 2010, one company spent several hundred million dollars laying a new fibre-optic cable between Chicago and New York simply to cut a few milliseconds from the transmission time. (IV) Shares were first traded in the coffee houses of seventeenth-century Amsterdam and London. (V) Some firms have since replaced such cables with chains of microwave towers, because signals travel faster through air than through glass.
exercises.question: Paragrafta anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
options: I
II
III
IV
V
exercises.explanation: Paragraf, algoritmayla işlem yapan şirketler için saniyenin milyonda birinin bile önemli olduğunu ve iletim süresini kısaltmak için yapılan yatırımları anlatır. ‘IV’ numaralı cümle de hisse ticaretiyle ilgilidir ama hız konusundan ayrılıp ticaretin tarihine geçer. ‘I’ algoritmik işlemi tanıtır, ‘II’ gecikmenin bedelini, ‘III’ kablo yatırımını anlatır; ‘V’ ise ‘such cables’ ile ‘III’ e bağlanarak mikrodalga kulelerine geçişi açıklar.

nodes.title: Ünite testi
nodes.description: 15 karışık soru; geçmek için %80 doğru yap

exercises.question: The number of countries that still change their clocks twice a year ---- steadily since the 1990s.
options: has fallen
have fallen
are falling
fell
falling
exercises.explanation: Özne ‘The number of countries’ tekildir (çekirdek isim ‘number’) ve ‘since the 1990s’ şimdiki mükemmel zaman ister: ‘has fallen’. ‘have fallen’ ve ‘are falling’ çoğul fiildir; ‘fell’ geçmiş zamandır ve ‘since’ ile uyuşmaz; ‘falling’ ise çekimli bir fiil değildir ve cümle ana fiilsiz kalır.

exercises.question: ---- the official deadline had already passed, the committee agreed to accept late applications for one more week.
options: Because
Even though
Unless
As long as
So that
exercises.explanation: Son tarihin geçmiş olmasına rağmen komite geç başvuruları kabul etmiştir; bu beklenmedik sonucu ‘Even though’ bağlar. ‘Because’ neden bildirir ve mantığı bozar; ‘Unless’ ve ‘As long as’ koşul bildirir ve geçmişte olmuş bir olguya uymaz; ‘So that’ ise amaç bildirir.

exercises.question: Several geophysicists have tried to ---- the claim that the Earth's rotation is speeding up, arguing that the measurements cover too short a period to be reliable.
options: enhance
obtain
refute
expand
attribute
exercises.explanation: Ölçümlerin güvenilir olmadığını savunarak bir iddiaya karşı çıkmak ‘refute’ (çürütmek) ile anlatılır. ‘enhance’ (geliştirmek) ve ‘expand’ (genişletmek) iddiaya karşı çıkmayı anlatmaz; ‘obtain’ (elde etmek) bir iddiayla kullanılmaz; ‘attribute’ ise ‘to’ ile bir nedene bağlamak demektir.

exercises.question: Because of the country's huge public debt, the government has introduced strict ---- measures, including cuts in pensions and a freeze on public-sector hiring.
options: prosperity
liquidity
remittance
austerity
equity
exercises.explanation: Kamu borcu yüzünden emekli maaşlarında kesinti ve işe alım dondurma gibi önlemler ‘austerity measures’ (kemer sıkma önlemleri) olarak adlandırılır. ‘prosperity’ (refah) kesintilerle çelişir; ‘liquidity’ (nakit akışkanlığı) ve ‘equity’ (öz sermaye, hakkaniyet) önlem türü bildirmez; ‘remittance’ ise yurt dışından gönderilen paradır.

exercises.passage: Until the 1970s, many athletics races were timed by officials (1)---- held stopwatches and pressed the button when they saw the runner cross the line. Because human reaction time varies, two officials timing the same runner could record results that differed (2)---- as much as a tenth of a second. Electronic timing, which is started automatically by the starter's gun, has made such disagreements far less common.
exercises.question: (1) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
options: which
whose
whom
where
who
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonra gelen ‘held stopwatches’ yan cümlenin yüklemidir ve öznesi eksiktir; insanları (‘officials’) niteleyen özne ilgi zamiri ‘who’ dur. ‘which’ insanlar için kullanılmaz; ‘whose’ bir isim ister (whose watches); ‘whom’ nesne zamiridir; ‘where’ ise yer bildirir.

exercises.passage: Until the 1970s, many athletics races were timed by officials (1)---- held stopwatches and pressed the button when they saw the runner cross the line. Because human reaction time varies, two officials timing the same runner could record results that differed (2)---- as much as a tenth of a second. Electronic timing, which is started automatically by the starter's gun, has made such disagreements far less common.
exercises.question: (2) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
options: by
with
at
of
on
exercises.explanation: İki ölçüm arasındaki farkın miktarı ‘differ by’ ile verilir: ‘differed by as much as a tenth of a second’ (saniyenin onda biri kadar farklıydı). ‘with’, ‘at’, ‘of’ ve ‘on’ ‘differ’ fiiliyle farkın miktarını bildirmez.

exercises.question: The deadline for the project was so tight that ----.
options: even if the client had approved the final design
the team had to work through two weekends to deliver it on time
which the team members found surprisingly relaxing
although nobody complained about the schedule
the team members had plenty of time to rest
exercises.explanation: ‘so tight that’ (o kadar sıkı ki) bir sonuç cümlesi ister: ekip işi zamanında teslim etmek için iki hafta sonu çalışmak zorunda kalmıştır: ‘the team had to work through two weekends to deliver it on time’. ‘even if’ ve ‘although’ ile başlayan seçenekler ana cümle değildir; ‘which … relaxing’ bir yan cümledir; ‘plenty of time to rest’ ise sıkı bir son tarihle çelişir.

exercises.question: ----, the town's population would have fallen far more sharply over the last decade.
options: Unless the municipal council invests in housing
As the birth rate has risen steadily since 2015
If the new port had not created thousands of jobs
Even though many young people moved to the capital
Since the port will be expanded next year
exercises.explanation: ‘would have fallen’ geçmişe ait gerçek dışı (üçüncü tip) bir koşulun sonucudur ve ‘If … had not created’ ister: ‘If the new port had not created thousands of jobs’. ‘Unless … invests’ gerçek bir gelecek koşuludur; ‘birth rate has risen’ ve ‘Even though … moved’ koşul kurmaz; ‘will be expanded’ ise gelecek zaman bildirir ve ‘would have’ ile uyuşmaz.

exercises.question:
Aşağıdaki İngilizce cümlenin anlamca en yakın Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?

The longer the meeting went on, the less attention the participants seemed to pay to the speakers.
options: Toplantı uzun sürdüğü için katılımcılar konuşmacıları hiç dinlemedi.
Katılımcılar konuşmacılara dikkat etseydi toplantı bu kadar uzun sürmezdi.
Konuşmacılar, katılımcıların dikkatini çekmek için toplantıyı uzattılar.
Toplantı uzadıkça katılımcılar konuşmacılara giderek daha az dikkat ediyor gibi görünüyordu.
Toplantı ne kadar kısa olursa katılımcılar o kadar az dikkat ederdi.
exercises.explanation: ‘The longer …, the less …’ (… uzadıkça … daha az) ve ‘seemed to’ (gibi görünüyordu) öğelerinin hepsi ‘Toplantı uzadıkça katılımcılar konuşmacılara giderek daha az dikkat ediyor gibi görünüyordu.’ cümlesinde vardır. ‘hiç dinlemedi’ dereceli azalmayı mutlak bir yargıya çevirir; ‘etseydi … sürmezdi’ gerçek dışı bir koşul kurar; ‘uzattılar’ toplantıyı uzatanı değiştirir; ‘ne kadar kısa’ ise ilişkiyi tersine çevirir.

exercises.question:
Aşağıdaki Türkçe cümlenin anlamca en yakın İngilizce karşılığı hangisidir?

Yeni yasa, büyük şirketlerin vergi beyannamelerini en geç yıl sonuna kadar vermelerini zorunlu kılıyor.
options: The new law requires large companies to submit their tax returns until the end of the year.
The new law will allow large companies to delay their tax returns until next year.
Large companies submitted their tax returns before the new law came into force.
The new law exempts large companies from submitting tax returns at the end of the year.
The new law requires large companies to submit their tax returns by the end of the year.
exercises.explanation: ‘en geç … -e kadar’ bir son tarih bildirir ve İngilizcede ‘by’ ile verilir; ‘zorunlu kılıyor’ ise ‘requires’ demektir: ‘The new law requires large companies to submit their tax returns by the end of the year.’ ‘until the end of the year’ süreklilik bildirir ve bir son tarih anlamı vermez; ‘allow … delay’ zorunluluğu ertelemeye çevirir; ‘came into force’ yasanın yürürlüğe girişinden önceki bir olayı anlatır; ‘exempts’ ise şirketleri yükümlülükten muaf tutar.

exercises.passage: On sailing ships, time was measured with sandglasses rather than clocks, because pendulum clocks could not keep accurate time on a rolling deck. A half-hour glass marked the length of each watch: every time the sand ran out, a sailor turned the glass and struck the ship's bell, and after eight bells the crew changed. Smaller glasses lasting about thirty seconds were used together with a knotted rope to estimate the ship's speed, which is why speed at sea is still measured in knots.
exercises.question: It is clear from the passage that the use of the word "knot" as a unit of speed ----.
options: comes from a method that combined a rope with a small sandglass
was introduced when pendulum clocks became reliable at sea
refers to the number of times the ship's bell was struck
was used only on ships that had no half-hour glass
replaced the system of eight bells after each watch
exercises.explanation: Parçanın son cümlesi küçük kum saatlerinin düğümlü bir halatla birlikte hız ölçmek için kullanıldığını ve bu yüzden denizde hızın hâlâ ‘knot’ ile ölçüldüğünü söyler: ‘comes from a method that combined a rope with a small sandglass’. Sarkaçlı saatler (‘pendulum’) gemide doğru çalışmadığı için kullanılmamıştır; zil vuruşu (‘bell’) nöbet değişimini gösterir, hızı değil; yarım saatlik kum saati olmayan gemiler (‘half-hour’) ve sekiz zil sisteminin yerini alma (‘replaced’) parçada geçmez.

exercises.passage:
Ayşe: The library has extended its opening hours until midnight during the exam period.
Tom: ----
Ayşe: True, but at least we won't have to compete for desks in the afternoon any more.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: When does the exam period start this year?
That's good news, though I doubt many people will actually stay that late.
I've never been inside the new library building.
So the library will close earlier than usual, then?
Great, I'll ask the librarian to lend me that book.
exercises.explanation: Ayşe ‘True, but at least …’ diyerek Tom’un bir çekincesini kabul edip olumlu bir yan ekler; bu, haberi iyi bulan ama pek az kişinin o kadar geç kalacağından kuşku duyan ‘That's good news, though I doubt many people will actually stay that late.’ yanıtına uyar. Sınav döneminin başlangıcı (‘When’) bir sorudur ve ‘True’ ile yanıtlanmaz; binaya hiç girmemiş olmak (‘never’) ve kitap ödünç almak (‘librarian’) Ayşe’nin yanıtını hazırlamaz; ‘close earlier’ ise saatlerin uzatıldığı bilgisiyle çelişir.

exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Not only did the new software reduce processing time, but it also cut the company's energy costs.
options: Although the new software reduced processing time, it increased the company's energy costs.
The company's energy costs fell, so it bought new software to reduce processing time.
The new software both shortened processing time and lowered the company's energy costs.
The new software reduced processing time only because energy costs had been cut.
Neither processing time nor energy costs were affected by the new software.
exercises.explanation: ‘Not only … but also’ iki olumlu sonucu birlikte bildirir; aynı anlamı ‘both … and’ ile kurulan ‘The new software both shortened processing time and lowered the company's energy costs.’ verir. ‘Although … increased’ ikinci sonucu tersine çevirir; ‘so it bought’ neden-sonuç ilişkisi uydurur; ‘only because … had been cut’ sıralamayı değiştirir; ‘Neither … nor’ ise iki etkiyi de yok sayar.

exercises.passage: Geographically, most of Spain lies at roughly the same longitude as Britain and Portugal, yet its clocks are set one hour ahead of theirs. ---- Some economists argue that this mismatch partly explains why Spaniards eat dinner so late and sleep less than most other Europeans. Several proposals to move the country back to its natural time zone have been discussed in parliament, but none has been approved so far.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Spain is one of the most popular tourist destinations in Europe.
Portugal and Spain share a long border and many cultural traditions.
In summer, most Spanish cities experience very high temperatures.
This is because in 1940 the government moved the country onto Central European Time, and the change was never reversed.
Britain, by contrast, has never adopted the European single currency.
exercises.explanation: İlk cümle İspanya’nın saatlerinin coğrafi konumuna göre bir saat ileri olduğunu söyler; boşluk bunun nedenini açıklamalı, ardından gelen ‘this mismatch’ ifadesine de zemin hazırlamalıdır: ‘This is because in 1940 the government moved the country onto Central European Time, and the change was never reversed.’ Turizm (‘tourist’), ortak sınır (‘border’), yaz sıcakları (‘temperatures’) ve ortak para birimi (‘currency’) saat farkını açıklamaz.

exercises.passage: (I) In many hospitals, nurses work twelve-hour shifts, often starting at seven in the evening and finishing at seven in the morning. (II) Nursing was one of the first professions to offer women a respected career in the nineteenth century. (III) Working at night disrupts the body's internal clock, which controls hormones, digestion and body temperature. (IV) Over many years, this disruption appears to increase the risk of heart disease and diabetes. (V) For this reason, some hospitals now limit the number of consecutive night shifts that a nurse may work.
exercises.question: Paragrafta anlam bütünlüğünü bozan cümle hangisidir?
options: I
II
III
IV
V
exercises.explanation: Paragraf hemşirelerin gece vardiyalarının biyolojik saati bozmasını, bunun sağlık risklerini ve hastanelerin aldığı önlemi anlatır. ‘II’ numaralı cümle de hemşirelikle ilgilidir ama vardiya ve sağlık konusundan ayrılıp mesleğin tarihine geçer. ‘I’ on iki saatlik gece vardiyasını tanıtır, ‘III’ biyolojik saatin bozulmasını, ‘IV’ ‘this disruption’ ile uzun vadeli riskleri anlatır; ‘V’ ise ‘For this reason’ ile hastanelerin önlemini verir.

nodes.title: Ünite ödülü
nodes.description: Üniteyi bitir, bonus XP kazan

nodes.title: Yarım deneme 4
nodes.description: YDS dağılımında 40 soru, 90 dakika (B1+–B2). Planın 27. haftasındaki yarım deneme; sonucunu önceki denemelerle karşılaştır.

exercises.question: The committee rejected the proposal on the grounds that the evidence offered in its support was largely ---- and could not be verified by independent researchers.
options: dominant
cumulative
reciprocal
anecdotal
peripheral
exercises.explanation: Bağımsız araştırmacılarca doğrulanamayan kanıt, kişisel gözlem ve hikâyelere dayanan kanıttır: ‘anecdotal’ (duyuma/anekdota dayalı). ‘dominant’ (baskın) ve ‘peripheral’ (ikincil, çevresel) kanıtın doğrulanamamasını açıklamaz; ‘cumulative’ (birikimli) kanıt daha güçlü olurdu; ‘reciprocal’ (karşılıklı) ise kanıtla anlamlı bir bağ kurmaz.

exercises.question: Because the symptoms of the two diseases ---- to a considerable extent, physicians often find it difficult to make an accurate diagnosis without laboratory tests.
options: overlap
dissolve
plummet
rotate
culminate
exercises.explanation: İki hastalığın belirtileri büyük ölçüde örtüştüğü için doktorlar laboratuvar testi olmadan doğru tanı koymakta zorlanır: ‘overlap’ (örtüşmek). ‘dissolve’ (çözünmek) ve ‘rotate’ (dönmek) belirtiler için anlamsızdır; ‘plummet’ (hızla düşmek) ‘to a considerable extent’ ile birlikte tanı güçlüğünü açıklamaz; ‘culminate’ (doruğa ulaşmak) ise ‘in’ ile kullanılır ve anlam vermez.

exercises.question: The company's sudden collapse was not caused by a single mistake; rather, it was the ---- result of years of poor decisions and inadequate audits.
options: temporal
lateral
cumulative
elastic
optical
exercises.explanation: Çöküş tek bir hatadan değil yıllarca biriken kötü kararlardan kaynaklanmıştır; bu birikimi ‘cumulative’ (birikimli, birikerek oluşan) anlatır. ‘temporal’ (zamansal), ‘lateral’ (yanal), ‘elastic’ (esnek) ve ‘optical’ (optik) yılların birikimini anlatan bir sonuç bildirmez.

exercises.question: The soil samples ---- from the volcanic slopes last spring contained unusually high levels of potassium and other minerals.
options: were collected
collected
which collecting
have collected
are collecting

exercises.question: By the time the rescue team reached the village, most of the residents ---- to higher ground.
options: evacuate
are evacuating
will have been evacuated
have evacuated
had already been evacuated
exercises.explanation: ‘By the time … reached’ geçmişteki bir andan önce tamamlanmış bir eylemi ister; sakinler başkaları tarafından tahliye edildiği için edilgen geçmiş zamanın hikâyesi gelir: ‘had already been evacuated’. ‘evacuate’ ve ‘are evacuating’ şimdiki zamandır; ‘will have been evacuated’ gelecek zamana aittir; ‘have evacuated’ ise hem zaman uyumunu bozar hem de etken çatıdadır.

exercises.question: The regulators were cautious: only after the results had been replicated by two independent laboratories ---- the new drug for general use.
options: did they approve
they approved
they have approved
approved they
they would approve
exercises.explanation: ‘Only after …’ cümle başına geldiğinde ana cümlede devrik yapı gerekir ve olay geçmişte olduğu için ‘did they approve’ gelir. ‘they approved’ ve ‘they would approve’ devrik değildir; ‘they have approved’ hem devrik değildir hem de geçmiş zaman uyumunu bozar; ‘approved they’ ise yardımcı fiilsiz yanlış bir devrik yapıdır.

exercises.question: ---- the tremendous cost of the project, the city council approved it by a large majority, arguing that it would pay for itself within a decade.
options: Although
Because of
In spite of
As long as
So that
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonra bir isim öbeği (‘the tremendous cost’) gelir ve maliyetin yüksekliğiyle projenin onaylanması arasında zıtlık vardır; bu yüzden ‘In spite of’ doğrudur. ‘Although’ ve ‘As long as’ yan cümle ister, isim öbeği almaz; ‘Because of’ yapıca uyar ama yüksek maliyeti onay nedeni yapar ki anlamsızdır; ‘So that’ amaç bildirir ve yine yan cümle ister.

exercises.question: The new irrigation system, ---- was installed on the farm in 2019, has reduced its water consumption by nearly a third.
options: that
where
whose
which
what
exercises.explanation: Virgülle ayrılmış, cansız bir ismi (‘The new irrigation system’) niteleyen ve kendi öznesi olmayan sıfat cümlesi ‘which’ ile kurulur. ‘that’ virgüllü (tanımlayıcı olmayan) sıfat cümlesinde kullanılmaz; ‘where’ bir yer bildirir ve arkasından özne ister; ‘whose’ arkasından bir isim gerektirir; ‘what’ ise sıfat cümlesi başlatmaz.

exercises.passage: Before the 1840s, when ether and nitrous oxide were first used to make surgery painless, a visit to the dentist was an experience that most people (1)---- for as long as possible. Treatment usually meant extraction, and it was frequently carried out not by trained specialists but by barbers, blacksmiths and travelling performers who pulled teeth at markets and fairs. Some of these practitioners were skilled and careful. (2)----, many others caused serious injuries, breaking teeth or even jaws, and their tools were rarely cleaned between patients, which meant that infections were common. Patients had few ways of (3)---- the pain. Some drank large quantities of alcohol or took opium, while others were simply held down in the chair by assistants. (4)---- such methods, it is hardly surprising that many people chose to endure toothache for months rather than face the extractor. It was only when anaesthetics became widely available that dentistry began to develop into a respected profession with its own schools, (5)---- students were trained in both surgery and hygiene.
exercises.question: (1) numaralı boşluğa hangisi gelmelidir?
options: accumulated
contradicted
reinforced
simulated
postponed
exercises.explanation: Ağrısız cerrahiden önce diş hekimine gitmek insanların ‘olabildiğince uzun süre’ ertelediği bir deneyimdi: ‘postponed’ (ertelemek). ‘accumulated’ (biriktirmek) ve ‘reinforced’ (güçlendirmek) bir ziyaret için anlam vermez; ‘contradicted’ (çelişmek) deneyimle uyuşmaz; ‘simulated’ (benzetimini yapmak) ise ‘for as long as possible’ ile bağdaşmaz.

provoking

options: which
who
where
what
