exercises.question: Unless urgent measures are taken to protect the remaining wetlands, ----.
options: many bird species had already disappeared from the region
many of the bird species that depend on them are likely to disappear within a generation
although the government has promised to increase their protection
the wetlands would have been saved by local volunteers
which is why tourism in the region has grown steadily
exercises.explanation: ‘Unless … are taken’ gerçek bir koşul kurar ve ana cümlede gelecekteki olası bir sonuç ister: ‘many of the bird species that depend on them are likely to disappear within a generation’. ‘had already disappeared’ geçmişin hikâyesidir ve zaman uyumunu bozar; ‘although’ ve ‘which is why’ ile başlayan seçenekler ana cümle değildir; ‘would have been saved … volunteers’ ise gerçek dışı geçmiş koşula aittir.

exercises.question: ----, the researchers were able to identify the genes responsible for the disease.
options: Unless they have access to a larger dataset
Even if the funding had been withdrawn
So that the results can be published next year
Whereas the previous study failed completely
By comparing the DNA of thousands of patients with that of healthy volunteers
exercises.explanation: Ana cümle araştırmacıların genleri nasıl belirleyebildiğini anlatır; yöntemi bildiren ‘By comparing the DNA of thousands of patients with that of healthy volunteers’ cümleyi tamamlar. ‘Unless … have access’ şimdiki zamana ait bir koşuldur; ‘Even if … had been withdrawn’ gerçek dışı geçmişi gerçekleşmiş bir sonuçla karıştırır; ‘So that … published next year’ zaman uyumunu bozar; ‘Whereas … failed’ ise bir zıtlık kurar ama başarının nasıl elde edildiğini açıklamaz.

exercises.question: The ancient city was so well preserved under the desert sand that ----.
options: archaeologists have been able to reconstruct the daily lives of its inhabitants in remarkable detail
it was completely destroyed by a series of violent storms
historians know almost nothing about the people who lived there
whereas other cities in the region were abandoned
because the sand covered it very suddenly
exercises.explanation: ‘so … that’ yapısı ‘o kadar … ki’ anlamında bir sonuç ister; kentin çok iyi korunmasının doğal sonucu, arkeologların günlük yaşamı ayrıntılı biçimde yeniden kurabilmesidir: ‘archaeologists have been able to reconstruct …’. ‘completely destroyed’ ve ‘know almost nothing’ iyi korunmayla çelişir; ‘whereas’ ve ‘because’ ile başlayan seçenekler ‘that’ den sonra gelemez ve sonuç bildirmez.

exercises.question: Just as the invention of printing transformed the way knowledge was circulated in the fifteenth century, ----.
options: although few people could read at that time
because books became far cheaper than before
the first newspapers were therefore published in Germany
the internet has radically changed how information is shared today
so many scholars refused to use printed books
exercises.explanation: ‘Just as …’ iki durum arasında benzerlik kurar: matbaa nasıl bilginin dolaşımını değiştirdiyse internet de bugün bilginin paylaşımını değiştirmiştir: ‘the internet has radically changed how information is shared today’. ‘although’ ve ‘because’ ile başlayan seçenekler ana cümle değildir; ‘newspapers were therefore published’ benzerlik değil sonuç kurar; ‘scholars refused’ ise benzerlik yerine karşıt bir tepki anlatır.

exercises.question: Many economists believe that the new policy will fail, ----.
options: unless it had been introduced much earlier
so that it can be adopted by other countries
since it does not address the underlying causes of inflation
which they have strongly supported from the beginning
even though they have always predicted its failure
exercises.explanation: Ekonomistlerin politikanın başarısız olacağına inanmasının gerekçesi gerekir: ‘since it does not address the underlying causes of inflation’. ‘unless … had been introduced’ zaman uyumunu bozar; ‘so that … adopted’ amaç bildirir ve başarısızlık beklentisiyle çelişir; ‘strongly supported’ başarısızlık inancıyla uyuşmaz; ‘even though … predicted its failure’ ise zıtlık kurar ama iki parça arasında zıtlık yoktur.

exercises.question:
Aşağıdaki İngilizce cümlenin anlamca en yakın Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?

It is widely accepted that the decline of the empire stemmed not from a single defeat but from a long series of economic and political crises.
options: İmparatorluğun gerilemesinin tek bir yenilgiden değil, uzun bir ekonomik ve siyasi krizler dizisinden kaynaklandığı genel olarak kabul edilmektedir.
İmparatorluğun gerilemesinin uzun süren ekonomik ve siyasi krizlere rağmen tek bir yenilgiyle gerçekleştiği genel olarak kabul edilmektedir.
Bazı tarihçiler imparatorluğun gerilemesinin yalnızca ekonomik krizlerden kaynaklandığını ileri sürmektedir.
İmparatorluğun tek bir yenilgiden sonra gerilemesi, uzun bir ekonomik ve siyasi krizler dizisine yol açmıştır.
İmparatorluğun gerilemesinin nedenleri hâlâ tartışmalıdır, ancak siyasi krizlerin etkisi genel olarak reddedilmektedir.
exercises.explanation: ‘It is widely accepted that’ (genel olarak kabul edilmektedir), ‘stemmed from’ (kaynaklandı) ve ‘not from a single defeat but from a long series of … crises’ (tek bir yenilgiden değil, uzun bir krizler dizisinden) öğelerinin hepsi ‘…krizler dizisinden kaynaklandığı genel olarak kabul edilmektedir.’ cümlesinde vardır. ‘rağmen … yenilgiyle gerçekleştiği’ anlamı tersine çevirir; ‘Bazı tarihçiler … yalnızca’ hem genel kabulü hem de siyasi krizleri yok sayar; ‘yol açmıştır’ neden-sonuç ilişkisini tersine çevirir; ‘tartışmalıdır … reddedilmektedir’ ise cümlede bulunmayan bir tartışma ve ret ekler.

exercises.question:
Aşağıdaki Türkçe cümlenin anlamca en yakın İngilizce karşılığı hangisidir?

Toprağın mineral bileşimi üzümlerin tadını en az iklim kadar etkileyebilir; bu nedenle birbirine komşu iki bağdan çok farklı şaraplar elde edilebilir.
options: The climate affects the taste of grapes far more than the mineral composition of the soil, so neighbouring vineyards produce similar wines.
Since the mineral composition of the soil cannot affect the taste of grapes, two neighbouring vineyards may produce very different wines.
The mineral composition of the soil has been shown to determine the climate of two neighbouring vineyards.
Although the mineral composition of the soil affects the taste of grapes, wines from neighbouring vineyards are always identical.
The mineral composition of the soil can affect the taste of grapes at least as much as the climate; therefore, very different wines can be obtained from two neighbouring vineyards.
exercises.explanation: ‘en az iklim kadar etkileyebilir’ (can affect … at least as much as the climate), ‘bu nedenle’ (therefore) ve ‘çok farklı şaraplar elde edilebilir’ (very different wines can be obtained) öğelerini eksiksiz veren cümle ‘The mineral composition of the soil can affect the taste of grapes at least as much as the climate; therefore, …’ dır. ‘far more … similar wines’ karşılaştırmayı ve sonucu tersine çevirir; ‘cannot affect’ toprağın etkisini ortadan kaldırır; ‘determine the climate’ toprağı iklimin belirleyicisi yapar; ‘always identical’ ise farklı şaraplar yerine aynı şarapları anlatır.

exercises.question:
Aşağıdaki İngilizce cümlenin anlamca en yakın Türkçe karşılığı hangisidir?

Had the warning signs been taken seriously, the epidemic might have been contained before it reached the capital.
options: Uyarı işaretleri ciddiye alındığı için salgın başkente ulaşmadan kontrol altına alındı.
Uyarı işaretleri ciddiye alınmış olsaydı, salgın başkente ulaşmadan önce kontrol altına alınabilirdi.
Uyarı işaretleri ciddiye alınsa bile salgın yine de başkente ulaşacaktı.
Salgın başkente ulaştıktan sonra uyarı işaretleri ciddiye alınmaya başlandı.
Uyarı işaretleri ciddiye alınmadığından salgın başkentte hiçbir zaman kontrol altına alınamadı.
exercises.explanation: ‘Had … been taken seriously’ geçmişe ait gerçek dışı bir koşuldur (ciddiye alınmış olsaydı), ‘might have been contained’ ise gerçekleşmemiş bir olasılık bildirir (kontrol altına alınabilirdi): ‘…ciddiye alınmış olsaydı, salgın başkente ulaşmadan önce kontrol altına alınabilirdi.’ ‘alındığı için … alındı’ olayları gerçekleşmiş gibi anlatır; ‘alınsa bile … yine de’ koşulu zıtlığa çevirir; ‘ulaştıktan sonra … başlandı’ cümlede olmayan bir sıralama kurar; ‘hiçbir zaman … alınamadı’ ise olasılığı kesin bir sonuca dönüştürür.

exercises.passage: Cities are often several degrees warmer than the countryside that surrounds them, a phenomenon known as the urban heat island. Asphalt, concrete and brick absorb solar radiation during the day and release it slowly at night, while the scarcity of vegetation means that little moisture evaporates to cool the air. In recent decades, planners in many countries have turned to trees as a relatively cheap way of mitigating this problem. A mature tree cools its surroundings in two ways. Its leaves block a large proportion of incoming sunlight, so that pavements and walls beneath them remain far cooler than exposed surfaces, and the water that it releases through its leaves absorbs heat as it evaporates. Measurements taken in several European cities indicate that streets lined with trees can be up to five degrees cooler at midday than comparable streets without them. However, the benefits are not distributed evenly. Studies in the United States have repeatedly found that wealthier districts tend to have far more tree cover than poorer ones, which are frequently located near industrial zones and major roads. As a consequence, the residents who are most vulnerable to extreme heat, including elderly people living alone, often receive the least protection. Some municipal authorities have therefore launched programmes that give priority to planting in neglected neighbourhoods. Such initiatives, though welcome, face practical constraints. A young tree may take fifteen years to provide meaningful shade, and many young trees die within their first few summers because they are not watered regularly. In addition, roots can damage underground pipes and cables, which makes some engineers reluctant to approve planting in narrow streets. Experts therefore argue that trees should be regarded not as a quick solution but as a long-term investment, one whose value will become evident only if cities commit to maintaining them for decades.
exercises.question: The passage is mainly concerned with ----.
options: the reasons why trees grow more slowly in cities than in the countryside
the damage that tree roots cause to underground pipes and cables
the role of trees in cooling cities and the obstacles to using them fairly and effectively
the history of the urban heat island in European cities
how wealthy residents have prevented trees from being planted in poorer districts
exercises.explanation: Metin ağaçların kentleri nasıl serinlettiğini, bu yararın eşit dağılmadığını ve ağaç dikme programlarının karşılaştığı güçlükleri anlatır: ‘the role of trees in cooling cities and the obstacles to using them fairly and effectively’. Ağaçların kentte daha yavaş büyüdüğü (‘slowly’) söylenmez; köklerin borulara verdiği zarar (‘damage’) yalnızca bir ayrıntıdır; ısı adasının tarihi (‘history’) anlatılmaz; varlıklı sakinlerin ağaç dikimini engellediği (‘prevented’) de ileri sürülmez.

exercises.question: According to the passage, trees cool their surroundings by ----.
options: releasing heat slowly at night after absorbing it during the day
reducing the amount of traffic on major roads
attracting rainfall to areas that would otherwise remain dry
shading surfaces from sunlight and releasing water that absorbs heat as it evaporates
replacing asphalt and concrete with softer natural materials

exercises.question: It can be inferred from the passage that residents of poorer districts ----.

have refused to allow new trees to be planted in their streets

are responsible for watering the young trees planted by the authorities

Asphalt, concrete and brick absorb solar radiation during the day and release it slowly at night, while the scarcity of vegetation means that little moisture evaporates to cool the air. Its leaves block a large proportion of incoming sunlight, so that pavements and walls beneath them remain far cooler than exposed surfaces, and the water that it releases through its leaves absorbs heat as it evaporates. Measurements taken in several European cities indicate that streets lined with trees can be up to five degrees cooler at midday than comparable streets without them. However, the benefits are not distributed evenly. Studies in the United States have repeatedly found that wealthier districts tend to have far more tree cover than poorer ones, which are frequently located near industrial zones and major roads. As a consequence, the residents who are most vulnerable to extreme heat, including elderly people living alone, often receive the least protection. Some municipal authorities have therefore launched programmes that give priority to planting in neglected neighbourhoods. Such initiatives, though welcome, face practical constraints. A young tree may take fifteen years to provide meaningful shade, and many young trees die within their first few summers because they are not watered regularly. In addition, roots can damage underground pipes and cables, which makes some engineers reluctant to approve planting in narrow streets. Experts therefore argue that trees should be regarded not as a quick solution but as a long-term investment, one whose value will become evident only if cities commit to maintaining them for decades.
exercises.question: The author's attitude towards tree-planting programmes can best be described as ----.
options: openly hostile
entirely indifferent
uncritically enthusiastic
deeply pessimistic
supportive but realistic
exercises.explanation: Yazar bu girişimleri olumlu karşılar (‘though welcome’) ama fidanların yavaş büyümesi, bakımsızlık ve köklerin verdiği zarar gibi kısıtları da açıkça belirtir; bu tutum ‘supportive but realistic’ tir. ‘openly hostile’ yazarın girişimleri hoş karşılamasıyla çelişir; ‘entirely indifferent’ ayrıntılı değerlendirmesiyle uyuşmaz; ‘uncritically enthusiastic’ sıraladığı güçlükleri yok sayar; ‘deeply pessimistic’ ise ağaçları uzun vadeli bir yatırım olarak görmesine uymaz.

exercises.passage: Long before the invention of refrigeration, salt was one of the few reliable means of preserving meat and fish, and this made it one of the most valuable commodities of the ancient world. Communities that lived near the sea could obtain it by evaporating seawater in shallow pools, but people further inland depended on merchants who transported it over great distances. In the Sahara, for instance, salt was cut in large blocks from dried lake beds and carried south by camel caravans to markets in West Africa, where it was exchanged for gold, ivory and other goods. Some historians claim that, in certain periods, a block of salt could be traded for an equal weight of gold, although such accounts are probably exaggerated. In the Mediterranean, the trade had equally important consequences. The Romans built one of their earliest roads, the Via Salaria, to carry salt from the coast to settlements in the interior, and soldiers were sometimes given an allowance with which to buy it. It is often said that the English word "salary" is derived from this practice, but the claim is debatable, since the evidence for it in ancient texts is surprisingly limited. What is clear is that whoever controlled the supply of salt possessed considerable power. Rulers in China and elsewhere imposed heavy taxes on it, and in some cases they established a state monopoly, which provided a large share of government revenue. Because salt was a necessity rather than a luxury, such taxes were particularly resented by the poor, and they provoked a number of revolts. The decline of the salt trade came only gradually. Once new methods of preservation, such as canning and refrigeration, became widely available, salt lost much of its economic importance, and today it is so cheap that few people think about where it comes from.
exercises.question: Which of the following could be the best title for the passage?
options: How Camels Changed the Sahara
Salt as a Source of Wealth and Power in the Ancient World
The Origins of the Word Salary
Why Gold Lost Its Value in West Africa
Modern Methods of Preserving Meat and Fish
exercises.explanation: Metin tuzun eski dünyada neden değerli olduğunu, nasıl ticaretinin yapıldığını ve onu denetleyenlere nasıl güç sağladığını anlatır: ‘Salt as a Source of Wealth and Power in the Ancient World’. Develer (‘Camels’) yalnızca Sahra örneğindeki taşıma aracıdır; ‘salary’ sözcüğünün kökeni (‘Origins’) tek bir ayrıntıdır ve yazar bunu tartışmalı bulur; altının değer yitirdiği (‘Gold Lost’) söylenmez; modern saklama yöntemleri (‘Modern Methods’) ise yalnızca son cümlelerde, tuz ticaretinin gerilemesini açıklamak için anılır.

was the route along which soldiers received their pay in gold
connected the salt lakes of the Sahara with the Mediterranean coast
was constructed to transport salt from the coast to settlements in the interior
was destroyed during the revolts against heavy salt taxes

heavy taxes
the poor

exercises.passage:
Selin: Our results show that students who sleep fewer than six hours a night perform worse in exams.
Mark: ----
Selin: Good point. We should check whether those students also work part-time or have heavier course loads.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: That's exactly what we predicted in our original proposal.
Most of the students in our sample live on campus.
But couldn't another factor explain both the lack of sleep and the lower grades?
We should publish the findings in a popular magazine first.
Exams are usually held at the end of each semester.
exercises.explanation: Selin ‘Good point’ diyerek öğrencilerin yarı zamanlı çalışıp çalışmadığını kontrol etmeyi önerir; bu, uykusuzluğu ve düşük notları birlikte açıklayabilecek başka bir etken sorusuna verilen yanıttır: ‘But couldn't another factor explain both the lack of sleep and the lower grades?’ ‘predicted’ itiraz değil onaydır; kampüste yaşamak (‘campus’) ve sınav takvimi (‘semester’) Selin’in yanıtını hazırlamaz; dergide yayımlama (‘magazine’) önerisi ise başka etkenlerin denetlenmesiyle ilgili değildir.

Anna: ----
Kerem: I agree. Scanning fragile documents is slow, and each page has to be handled with great care.
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Digital copies are usually cheaper to store than paper ones.
That sounds rather ambitious for such a large and delicate collection.
Most visitors prefer to see the original documents.
The museum was founded more than a century ago.
They should have finished the project much earlier.
exercises.explanation: Kerem ‘I agree’ diyerek kırılgan belgeleri taramanın yavaş olduğunu söyler; bu, iki yıllık hedefin büyük ve hassas bir koleksiyon için fazla iddialı olduğu görüşüne verilen bir yanıttır: ‘That sounds rather ambitious for such a large and delicate collection.’ Dijital kopyaların ucuzluğu (‘cheaper’) ve ziyaretçilerin tercihi (‘visitors’) zaman sorunuyla ilgili değildir; müzenin kuruluş tarihi (‘founded’) konu dışıdır; ‘finished … much earlier’ ise işin yavaşlığı vurgusuyla çelişir.

exercises.passage:
Zeynep: I've been reading about cooperative game theory for my seminar, but I find the idea of a coalition confusing.
David: ----
Zeynep: So the main question is how the players should share the benefits they gain by working together?
exercises.question: Diyalogdaki boşluğa hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Game theory was developed mainly by mathematicians in the twentieth century.
You should ask your tutor to postpone the seminar.
Most people find competitive games more entertaining than cooperative ones.
Coalitions are rarely studied by economists nowadays.
It's simply a group of players who agree to act together because they all gain more that way.
exercises.explanation: Zeynep koalisyon kavramını anlamadığını söyler, sonra ‘So the main question is how the players should share the benefits …’ diyerek bir tanımı özetler; bu tanım ‘It's simply a group of players who agree to act together because they all gain more that way.’ dır. exercises.question:
Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

Not until the soil samples had been analysed did the researchers realise how much the volcanic minerals affected the vines.
options: The researchers realised the importance of volcanic minerals before analysing any soil samples.
The soil samples showed that volcanic minerals had no effect on the vines.
The researchers analysed the soil samples because they already knew about the effect of volcanic minerals.
Only when the soil samples had been analysed did the researchers understand the extent to which volcanic minerals affected the vines.
The researchers examined the vines rather than the soil samples to measure the effect of volcanic minerals.
exercises.explanation: ‘Not until … did’ yapısı araştırmacıların ancak örnekler incelendikten sonra fark ettiğini anlatır; aynı anlamı ‘Only when the soil samples had been analysed did the researchers understand the extent to which …’ verir. ‘before analysing’ sıralamayı tersine çevirir; ‘no effect’ mineral etkisini ortadan kaldırır; ‘already knew’ fark etmenin incelemeden önce olduğunu söyler; ‘rather than’ ise toprak örneklerinin incelenmediğini ileri sürer.

Verilen cümleye anlamca en yakın cümle hangisidir?

The new treatment is by no means as effective as its supporters had claimed.
options: The new treatment is far less effective than its supporters had said it would be.
The new treatment is exactly as effective as its supporters had predicted.
Supporters of the new treatment claimed that it was not very effective.
The new treatment has proved more effective than anyone had expected.
Nobody has yet tested whether the new treatment is effective.
exercises.explanation: ‘by no means as effective as’ (hiç de … kadar etkili değil) tedavinin savunucularının iddia ettiğinden çok daha az etkili olduğunu anlatır: ‘The new treatment is far less effective than its supporters had said it would be.’ ‘exactly as effective’ ve ‘more effective than anyone had expected’ anlamı tersine çevirir; ‘Supporters … claimed … not very effective’ iddiayı savunuculara yanlış biçimde yükler; ‘Nobody has yet tested’ ise etkinliğin hiç ölçülmediğini söyler.

exercises.passage: Vineyards on the slopes of extinct volcanoes, such as those on the Canary Islands and in parts of Sicily, have long been admired for producing distinctive wines. ---- These minerals are gradually released as the rock weathers, and many winemakers believe that they give the wine a slightly salty, mineral taste. In addition, volcanic soils drain quickly, which forces the vines to send their roots deep underground in search of water.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: Wine has been produced in the Mediterranean region for thousands of years.
Many tourists visit these islands mainly to climb the old volcanoes.
The soils in these areas are rich in potassium, iron and other minerals derived from ancient lava.
Some winemakers prefer to store their wine in oak barrels for several years.
The price of land on such slopes has risen sharply in recent years.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan sonraki ‘These minerals are gradually released …’ cümlesi daha önce anılmış mineralleri gösterir; bu mineralleri tanıtan cümle ‘The soils in these areas are rich in potassium, iron and other minerals derived from ancient lava.’ dır. Akdeniz’de şarap üretiminin tarihi (‘thousands’), turistlerin yanardağlara tırmanması (‘tourists’), meşe fıçılar (‘barrels’) ve arazi fiyatları (‘price’) ‘These minerals’ ifadesine bağlanmaz.

exercises.passage: In cooperative game theory, players are allowed to form coalitions and make binding agreements with one another. The central problem is not whether they will cooperate but how the gains from cooperation should be divided. ---- According to this principle, each player receives a share that reflects the average contribution he or she makes to every possible coalition. Although the calculation can become extremely complex when there are many players, the method is now used in fields ranging from economics to machine learning.
exercises.question: Paragrafta boş bırakılan yere hangisi getirilmelidir?
options: In competitive games, by contrast, players cannot communicate with each other.
Chess is often described as the most famous game of strategy.
Many players find it difficult to trust their partners.
Economists have rarely shown any interest in mathematical models.
One influential answer was proposed by the mathematician Lloyd Shapley in 1953.
exercises.explanation: Boşluktan önce kazancın nasıl paylaşılacağı sorusu sorulur, sonra ‘According to this principle …’ ile bir ilke açıklanır; bu ilkeyi ortaya koyan cümle ‘One influential answer was proposed by the mathematician Lloyd Shapley in 1953.’ dır. Rekabetçi oyunlar (‘competitive’) ve satranç (‘Chess’) işbirliğine dayalı paylaşım ilkesini tanıtmaz; ortaklara güvenme güçlüğü (‘trust’) bir ilke değildir; ekonomistlerin ilgisizliği (‘rarely’) ise yöntemin ekonomide kullanıldığını söyleyen son cümleyle çelişir.

exercises.passage: (I) Before electricity, lighthouses relied on fires, candles or oil lamps, whose light could be seen only a few kilometres out to sea. (II) Many lighthouse keepers lived with their families in isolated cottages and were visited by supply boats only once a month. (III) In 1822, the French physicist Augustin Fresnel designed a lens made of rings of glass that bent scattered light into a single powerful beam. (IV) With this lens, even a modest lamp could be seen from more than thirty kilometres away. (V) Within a few decades, Fresnel lenses had been installed in lighthouses around the world, greatly reducing the number of shipwrecks.

exercises.passage: (I) Desert plants have developed a remarkable range of strategies for surviving long periods without rain. (II) Many cacti store water in thick, swollen stems and have replaced their leaves with spines, which lose far less moisture to the air. (III) Other species send their roots deep underground to reach water that lies several metres below the surface. (IV) Some desert plants have also been used for centuries by local people as sources of food, medicine and building material. (V) Still others survive the driest months only as seeds, which can remain in the soil for years until heavy rain finally allows them to grow.

options: I

exercises.passage: (I) In the 1960s and 1970s, many schools were built with open-plan classrooms, in which several classes shared one large space without walls. (II) Teachers soon reported that noise from neighbouring groups made it difficult for children to concentrate on reading and listening tasks. (III) The open-plan design was also considerably cheaper to build, since fewer walls and doors were needed. (IV) Later acoustic studies confirmed that background noise in such classrooms often exceeded recommended levels, particularly affecting younger pupils and those learning in a second language. (V) As a consequence, many of these schools were eventually rebuilt with partitions or sound-absorbing panels.

exercises.passage: (I) Documents proving that a person has been vaccinated have a longer history than many people realise. (II) Today most vaccines are given by injection, although a few, such as some polio vaccines, are swallowed as drops. (III) In the late nineteenth century, several countries began to require travellers and immigrants to show certificates of smallpox vaccination at their borders. (IV) In 1933, an international agreement introduced a standard form of certificate, and in 1969 the World Health Organization adopted the familiar yellow booklet. (V) These records allowed health officials to check quickly whether arriving passengers posed a risk of spreading disease.
